## Assistant

این تست **سه thread جدا** ایجاد می‌کند و با `CountDownLatch` هر سه درخواست `credit` را هم‌زمان آزاد می‌کند؛ سپس منتظر پایان **هر سه درخواست** می‌ماند و موجودی را از `get-balance` می‌گیرد و چاپ می‌کند.

به کلاس تست فعلی که `webTestClient` دارد اضافه کن:

```java
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

```

```java
@Value("${base-url}")
private String baseUrl;

@Test
void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance()
        throws Exception {

    String basePath = baseUrl.replaceAll("/+$", "");

    // 1. دریافت اولین تراکنش
    JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get()
            .uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/")
            .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .exchange()
            .expectStatus().isOk()
            .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
            .returnResult()
            .getResponseBody();

    assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
    assertTrue(
            transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(),
            "At least one transaction must exist"
    );

    JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

    // نام فیلدهای JSON را با TransactionResponse پروژه تطبیق بده.
    String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asText();
    String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asText();

    assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
    assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

    // مبلغ هر درخواست: 10000
    Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of(
            "accountId", accountId,
            "transactionId", transactionId,
            "amount", 10000L
    );

    System.out.printf(
            "Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n",
            accountId,
            transactionId
    );

    // 2. اجرای سه درخواست concurrent با یک transactionId
    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
    CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
    CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

    List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

    try {
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            final int requestNumber = i;

            futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                ready.countDown();

                if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Timed out waiting for concurrent start"
                    );
                }

                var result = webTestClient.post()
                        .uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .bodyValue(creditRequest)
                        .exchange()
                        .expectBody(String.class)
                        .returnResult();

                return String.format(
                        "Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s",
                        requestNumber,
                        result.getStatus(),
                        result.getResponseBody()
                );
            }));
        }

        // هر سه thread باید آماده باشند؛ سپس همگی آزاد می‌شوند.
        assertTrue(
                ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                "Credit workers did not become ready"
        );

        start.countDown();

        // قبل از دریافت موجودی، پایان هر سه درخواست را انتظار می‌کشیم.
        for (Future<String> future : futures) {
            System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        }

        // 3. دریافت و چاپ موجودی نهایی
        JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post()
                .uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/")
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId))
                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
                .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
                .returnResult()
                .getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

        System.out.printf(
                "Final balance for account %s: %s%n",
                accountId,
                balanceResponse.path("explanation").asText()
        );

    } finally {
        start.countDown();
        executor.shutdownNow();
    }
}
```

**نکات:**
- اگر شناسه در خروجی `TransactionResponse` با نام `transactionId` است، `path("id")` را به `path("transactionId")` تغییر بده.
- هر سه درخواست با **همان شناسه تراکنش** ارسال می‌شوند. اگر سرویس جلوگیری از پردازش تکراری دارد، ممکن است فقط یکی موفق شود؛ به همین دلیل وضعیت و بدنه هر سه پاسخ چاپ می‌شود و موفقیت هر سه فرض نشده است.
- شروع درخواست‌ها concurrent است، اما هم‌زمانی دقیق رسیدن آن‌ها به دیتابیس تضمین نمی‌شود؛ این به زمان‌بندی شبکه و سرور بستگی دارد.
- این تست موجودی را واقعاً تغییر می‌دهد؛ روی دیتابیس تست اجرا کن.

package com.backend.serviceBalance;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.payloads.responses.AccountResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransactionRequest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class ServiceBalanceApplicationTests {

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    @Test
    void createAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Hesam", "lastname", "Davarpanah", "username", "test_" + uniqueId, "email", "test_" + uniqueId + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        webTestClient.post().uri(baseURL + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectHeader().contentTypeCompatibleWith(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("User created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void createTransaction_forFirstAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        var accounts = webTestClient.get().uri("/api/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBodyList(AccountResponse.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response must not be null");
        assertFalse(accounts.isEmpty(), "At least one account must exist");

        var firstAccount = accounts.getFirst();

        var request = CreateTransactionRequest.builder().accountId(firstAccount.id()).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(10000L).build();

        webTestClient.post().uri("/api/transactions/create-transaction/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(), "At least one transaction must exist");

        JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

        String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asText();
        String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asText();

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

        Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", 10000L);

        System.out.printf("Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n", accountId, transactionId);

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                final int requestNumber = i;

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var result = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(creditRequest).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return String.format("Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s", requestNumber, result.getStatus(), result.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Credit workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<String> future : futures) System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf("Final balance for account %s: %s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asText());

        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

}

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId).flatMap(transaction -> completeCredit(account, transaction))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work).onErrorMap(DuplicateKeyException.class, _ -> new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Debit is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Transfer is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

    }

## Assistant

علت خطا اکنون مشخص است: **تراکنش از قبل با وضعیت `PENDING` وجود دارد، اما کد شما همیشه تلاش می‌کند همان شناسه را دوباره `INSERT` کند.**

```java
return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
```

این کار `DuplicateKeyException` ایجاد می‌کند و این خط، بدون بررسی محتوای تراکنش، آن را به conflict تبدیل می‌کند:

```java
.onErrorMap(DuplicateKeyException.class,
        _ -> new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId))
```

بنابراین در این مورد پیام «عملیات متفاوت» صحیح نیست.

## ۱. قفل خواندن تراکنش را به repository اضافه کن

```java
@Query("""
        SELECT *
        FROM transactions
        WHERE id = :transactionId
        FOR UPDATE
        """)
Mono<Transaction> findByIdForUpdate(
        @Param("transactionId") String transactionId
);
```

## ۲. متد `creditOnce` را جایگزین کن

منطق موردنظر:

- تراکنش وجود ندارد → ایجاد و اجرای credit.
- تراکنش موجود و مشخصات یکسان، وضعیت `PENDING` → تکمیل credit.
- تراکنش موجود و مشخصات یکسان، وضعیت `SUCCESS` → موفقیت بدون تغییر مجدد موجودی.
- مشخصات متفاوت → conflict.
- وضعیت دیگر → خطای وضعیت، نه اجرای مجدد خودکار.

```java
private Mono<Void> creditOnce(
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Mono<Void> work = accountRepository
                .findByIdForUpdate(accountId)
                .switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(
                        new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Account not found: " + accountId
                        )
                ))
                .flatMap(account ->
                        transactionRepository
                                .findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
                                .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                                        createPendingTransaction(
                                                accountId,
                                                amount,
                                                transactionId
                                        )
                                ))
                                .flatMap(transaction ->
                                        processCreditTransaction(
                                                account,
                                                transaction,
                                                accountId,
                                                amount,
                                                transactionId
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .then();

        return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
    });
}
```

**عمداً `onErrorMap(DuplicateKeyException.class, ...)` حذف شده است:** هر خطای duplicate الزاماً به معنی متفاوت بودن عملیات نیست.

## ۳. این متد را اضافه کن

```java
private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(
        Account account,
        Transaction transaction,
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAccountId(), accountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAmount(), amount
            )
            && transaction.getTransactionMethod()
                    == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(
                new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        // عملیات قبلاً انجام شده؛ موجودی دوباره تغییر نمی‌کند.
        return Mono.empty();
    }

    if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();
    }

    return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
            "Transaction cannot be credited in status "
                    + status + ": " + transactionId
    ));
}
```

متدهای `createPendingTransaction` و `completeCredit` فعلی می‌توانند بدون تغییر باقی بمانند.

### چرا سه درخواست یکسان دوباره موجودی را افزایش نمی‌دهند؟

برای **همان حساب**، `findByIdForUpdate(accountId)` درخواست‌ها را در تراکنش دیتابیس به‌ترتیب اجرا می‌کند:

1. درخواست اول تراکنش `PENDING` را تکمیل می‌کند و موجودی را افزایش می‌دهد.
2. درخواست دوم پس از آزادشدن قفل، تراکنش را `SUCCESS` می‌بیند و بدون افزایش موجودی تمام می‌شود.
3. درخواست سوم هم همین رفتار را دارد.

این نتیجه مشروط به آن است که `TransactionalOperator` از transaction manager همان اتصال R2DBC استفاده کند و تمام مسیرهای تغییر موجودی/تکمیل تراکنش، قواعد قفل‌گذاری سازگار داشته باشند.

## ۴. conflict واقعی را با `409` پاسخ بده

در `GlobalExceptionHandler`:

```java
@ExceptionHandler(IdempotencyConflictException.class)
public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleIdempotencyConflict(
        IdempotencyConflictException exception
) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT)
            .body(Map.of(
                    "title", "Idempotency Conflict",
                    "explanation", exception.getMessage()
            ));
}
```

Importهای لازم:

```java
import java.util.Map;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
```

## نتیجه مورد انتظار در تست فعلی

اگر موجودی اولیه `0` باشد و تراکنش همچنان `PENDING` و مبلغ آن `10000` باشد:

```text
Credit #1 -> 2xx
Credit #2 -> 2xx
Credit #3 -> 2xx

Final balance: 10000
Transaction status: SUCCESS
```

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) return Mono.empty();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Debit is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Transfer is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

package com.backend.serviceBalance.utils;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.exceptions.AccountAlreadyExistsException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.bind.support.WebExchangeBindException;
import org.springframework.web.server.ServerWebInputException;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(GlobalExceptionHandler.class);

    @ExceptionHandler(AccountAlreadyExistsException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse> handleUserAlreadyExists(AccountAlreadyExistsException exception) {
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, "Conflict", exception.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(WebExchangeBindException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse> handleValidation(WebExchangeBindException exception) {
        String explanation = exception.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream().map(error -> error.getField() + ": " + error.getDefaultMessage()).collect(Collectors.joining(" | "));

        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Validation Error", explanation.isBlank() ? "invalid input data" : explanation);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(ServerWebInputException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse> handleInvalidRequest() {
        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "Bad Request", "invalid body or method");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse> handleUnexpectedException(Exception exception) {
        log.error("Unexpected error while processing request", exception);

        return buildResponse(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Internal Server Error", "error, try again!");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IdempotencyConflictException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>> handleIdempotencyConflict(IdempotencyConflictException exception) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CONFLICT).body(Map.of("title", "Idempotency Conflict", "explanation", exception.getMessage()));
    }

    private ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse> buildResponse(HttpStatus status, String title, String explanation) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(status).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title(title).explanation(explanation).build());
    }
}

              "explanation": "100000"
            }

    @PostMapping(value = "/get-balance/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)

    }

}

```java
@Test
void creditAllTransactions_concurrently_thenPrintBalances() throws Exception {
    String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");

    // برای تست‌های concurrent مهلت پاسخ کمی بیشتر باشد.
    WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate()
            .responseTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(60))
            .build();

    JsonNode transactions = client.get()
            .uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/")
            .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
            .exchange()
            .expectStatus().isOk()
            .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
            .returnResult()
            .getResponseBody();

    assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
    assertTrue(transactions.isArray(), "Transactions response must be an array");

    record CreditJob(
            String transactionId,
            String accountId,
            long amount,
            int expectedStatus
    ) {}

    record CreditResult(
            CreditJob job,
            int actualStatus,
            String body
    ) {}

    List<CreditJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
    java.util.Set<String> accountIds = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();

    for (JsonNode transaction : transactions) {
        String method = transaction.path("transactionMethod").asString();
        String status = transaction.path("transactionStatus").asString();

        if (!TransactionMethod.CREDIT.name().equals(method)) {
            continue;
        }

        if (!"PENDING".equals(status) && !"SUCCESS".equals(status)) {
            System.out.printf(
                    "Skipped transaction %s: status=%s%n",
                    transaction.path("id").asString(),
                    status
            );
            continue;
        }

        String transactionId = transaction.path("id").asString();
        String accountId = transaction.path("accountId").asString();

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");
        assertTrue(transaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        long amount = transaction.path("amount").asLong();

        assertTrue(amount > 0, "Credit amount must be positive");

        jobs.add(new CreditJob(
                transactionId,
                accountId,
                amount,
                "PENDING".equals(status) ? 200 : 409
        ));

        accountIds.add(accountId);
    }

    assertFalse(jobs.isEmpty(), "No PENDING or SUCCESS CREDIT transactions found");

    int concurrency = Math.min(10, jobs.size());

    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(concurrency);
    CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

    List<Future<CreditResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
    List<CreditResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

    try {
        for (CreditJob job : jobs) {
            futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Timed out waiting for concurrent start"
                    );
                }

                var response = client.post()
                        .uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .bodyValue(Map.of(
                                "accountId", job.accountId(),
                                "transactionId", job.transactionId(),
                                "amount", job.amount()
                        ))
                        .exchange()
                        .expectBody(String.class)
                        .returnResult();

                return new CreditResult(
                        job,
                        response.getStatus().value(),
                        response.getResponseBody()
                );
            }));
        }

        // آزاد کردن workerها؛ درخواست‌ها در دسته‌های حداکثر ۱۰تایی اجرا می‌شوند.
        start.countDown();

        for (Future<CreditResult> future : futures) {
            CreditResult result = future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            results.add(result);

            System.out.printf(
                    "Transaction=%s | Account=%s | Amount=%d | Status=%d | Body=%s%n",
                    result.job().transactionId(),
                    result.job().accountId(),
                    result.job().amount(),
                    result.actualStatus(),
                    result.body()
            );
        }

        long successCount = results.stream()
                .filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 200)
                .count();

        long conflictCount = results.stream()
                .filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 409)
                .count();

        System.out.printf(
                "%nTotal=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n",
                results.size(),
                successCount,
                conflictCount,
                results.size() - successCount - conflictCount
        );

        // موجودی نهایی تمام حساب‌های مرتبط
        for (String accountId : accountIds) {
            JsonNode balanceResponse = client.post()
                    .uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/")
                    .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                    .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                    .bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId))
                    .exchange()
                    .expectStatus().isOk()
                    .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
                    .returnResult()
                    .getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf(
                    "Final balance | Account=%s | Balance=%s%n",
                    accountId,
                    balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString()
            );
        }

        // فقط چاپ خروجی کافی نیست؛ پاسخ‌ها واقعاً بررسی می‌شوند.
        assertAll(
                "Concurrent credit responses",
                results.stream().map(result ->
                        (org.junit.jupiter.api.function.Executable) () ->
                                assertEquals(
                                        result.job().expectedStatus(),
                                        result.actualStatus(),
                                        "Unexpected response for transaction "
                                                + result.job().transactionId()
                                                + ": " + result.body()
                                )
                )
        );

    } finally {
        start.countDown();
        executor.shutdownNow();
    }
}
```

## You

خب حالا باید debit نوشته بشه و از account.balance کم بشه

amount صفر و کمتر خطا - مبلغ درخواستی بیشتر از موجودی خطا

همه منطق هایی که توی credit برای concurrency و retry پیاده شده اینجا هم باید پیاده بشه

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.TransactionAlreadyCompletedException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Debit is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Transfer is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

## Assistant

برای `debit` هم همان ترتیب قفل‌گذاری `credit` را حفظ می‌کنیم: **ابتدا حساب، سپس تراکنش**. بررسی موجودی و کم‌کردن مبلغ نیز داخل همان تراکنش دیتابیس انجام می‌شود تا درخواست‌های همزمان باعث منفی‌شدن موجودی نشوند.

### ۱. متد `debit` را جایگزین و متدهای زیر را به کلاس اضافه کن

در این نسخه از همان `CreditRetryPolicy` و Circuit Breaker موجود استفاده شده است؛ بنابراین سیاست retry و concurrency با `credit` یکسان است.

```java
@Override
public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        validateDebit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

        return Mono.defer(() -> debitOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout))
                .retryWhen(
                        Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200))
                                .maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2))
                                .jitter(0.5)
                                .filter(error ->
                                        !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException)
                                                && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException)
                                                && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException)
                                                && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)
                                )
                                .onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())
                )
                .transformDeferred(
                        CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker)
                );
    });
}

private void validateDebit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
    if (accountId == null || accountId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account ID is required");
    }

    if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");
    }

    if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
    }
}

private Mono<Void> debitOnce(
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId)
                .switchIfEmpty(
                        Mono.error(
                                new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Account not found: " + accountId
                                )
                        )
                )
                .flatMap(account ->
                        transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
                                .switchIfEmpty(
                                        Mono.defer(() ->
                                                createPendingTransaction(
                                                        accountId,
                                                        amount,
                                                        transactionId,
                                                        TransactionMethod.DEBIT
                                                )
                                        )
                                )
                                .flatMap(transaction ->
                                        processDebitTransaction(
                                                account,
                                                transaction,
                                                accountId,
                                                amount,
                                                transactionId
                                        )
                                )
                )
                .then();

        return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
    });
}

private Mono<Void> processDebitTransaction(
        Account account,
        Transaction transaction,
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId)
                    && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount)
                    && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.DEBIT;

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        return Mono.error(
                new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return completeDebit(account, transaction).then();
    }

    return Mono.error(
            new IllegalStateException(
                    "Transaction cannot be debited in status "
                            + status + ": " + transactionId
            )
    );
}

private Mono<Transaction> completeDebit(
        Account account,
        Transaction transaction
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();
        Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

        if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(
                    new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid")
            );
        }

        // بررسی دفاعی مبلغ ذخیره‌شده در تراکنش
        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            return Mono.error(
                    new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Amount must be greater than zero"
                    )
            );
        }

        if (amount > currentBalance) {
            return Mono.error(
                    new InsufficientBalanceException(
                            account.getId(),
                            currentBalance,
                            amount
                    )
            );
        }

        // با توجه به شرط‌های بالا، تفریق overflow ندارد.
        account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

        return accountRepository.save(account)
                .flatMap(_ -> {
                    transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                    transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                    return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
                });
    });
}
```

### ۲. ساخت تراکنش `PENDING` را برای هر دو عملیات مشترک کن

متد فعلی `createPendingTransaction` را با این **دو overload** جایگزین کن. فراخوانی‌های فعلی `credit` بدون تغییر کار می‌کنند:

```java
private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return createPendingTransaction(
            accountId,
            amount,
            transactionId,
            TransactionMethod.CREDIT
    );
}

private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(
        String accountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId,
        TransactionMethod transactionMethod
) {
    LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

    Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder()
            .id(transactionId)
            .createdAt(now)
            .updatedAt(now)
            .transactionMethod(transactionMethod)
            .amount(amount)
            .accountId(accountId)
            .transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            .build();

    return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
}
```

### ۳. Exception موجودی ناکافی را اضافه کن

فایل `balances/exceptions/InsufficientBalanceException.java`:

```java
package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions;

public class InsufficientBalanceException extends RuntimeException {

    public InsufficientBalanceException(
            String accountId,
            long currentBalance,
            long requestedAmount
    ) {
        super(
                "Insufficient balance for account " + accountId
                        + ": currentBalance=" + currentBalance
                        + ", requestedAmount=" + requestedAmount
        );
    }
}
```

و import آن در سرویس:

```java
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.InsufficientBalanceException;
```

این exception را در exception handler پروژه به پاسخ مناسب، مثلاً `422 Unprocessable Entity`، نگاشت کن؛ در غیر این صورت ممکن است به `500` تبدیل شود.

### رفتار نهایی

| شرایط | نتیجه |
|---|---|
| مبلغ `null`، صفر یا منفی | خطای اعتبارسنجی |
| مبلغ بیشتر از موجودی | خطای موجودی ناکافی؛ بدون retry |
| مبلغ برابر موجودی | موفق؛ موجودی صفر می‌شود |
| تراکنش قبلاً `SUCCESS` شده | خطای تکراری؛ بدون برداشت مجدد |
| شناسه تراکنش با حساب، مبلغ یا نوع متفاوت | `IdempotencyConflictException` |
| خطای موقت قابل retry | اجرای مجدد کل تراکنش با قفل‌گذاری مجدد |
| خطا هنگام ذخیره حساب یا تراکنش | rollback هر دو تغییر |

**پیش‌شرط مهم:** متدهای `findByIdForUpdate` واقعاً باید قفل دیتابیس مانند `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` بگیرند و شناسه تراکنش باید `PRIMARY KEY` یا `UNIQUE` باشد. همچنین `credit` و `debit` فعلاً Circuit Breaker مشترک دارند؛ اگر بخواهی خرابی یکی روی دیگری اثر نگذارد، برای debit یک Circuit Breaker مستقل تعریف کن.

*Model: GPT-6.1 Sol*

## You

خب حالا همه تست هایی که برای CREDIT نوشته شده رو هم برای DEBIT بنویس و جوری بنویس که حتما race exception تو تست بررسی بشه

package com.backend.serviceBalance;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.payloads.responses.AccountResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransactionRequest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class ServiceBalanceApplicationTests {

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    @Test
    void createAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Hesam", "lastname", "Davarpanah", "username", "test_" + uniqueId, "email", "test_" + uniqueId + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        webTestClient.post().uri(baseURL + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectHeader().contentTypeCompatibleWith(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("User created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void createTransaction_forFirstAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        var accounts = webTestClient.get().uri("/api/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBodyList(AccountResponse.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response must not be null");
        assertFalse(accounts.isEmpty(), "At least one account must exist");

        var firstAccount = accounts.getFirst();

        var request = CreateTransactionRequest.builder().accountId(firstAccount.id()).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(10000L).build();

        webTestClient.post().uri("/api/transactions/create-transaction/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(), "At least one transaction must exist");

        JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

        String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asString();
        String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asString();

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        long amount = firstTransaction.path("amount").asLong();

        Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", amount);
        System.out.printf("Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n", accountId, transactionId);

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                final int requestNumber = i;

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var result = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(creditRequest).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return String.format("Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s", requestNumber, result.getStatus(), result.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Credit workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<String> future : futures) System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf("Final balance for account %s: %s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());

        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void creditAllTransactions_concurrently_thenPrintBalances() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        JsonNode transactions = client.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray(), "Transactions response must be an array");

        record CreditJob(String transactionId, String accountId, long amount, int expectedStatus) {
        }

        record CreditResult(CreditJob job, int actualStatus, String body) {
        }

        List<CreditJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> accountIds = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (JsonNode transaction : transactions) {
            String method = transaction.path("transactionMethod").asString();
            String status = transaction.path("transactionStatus").asString();

            if (!TransactionMethod.CREDIT.name().equals(method)) continue;

            if (!"PENDING".equals(status) && !"SUCCESS".equals(status)) {
                System.out.printf("Skipped transaction %s: status=%s%n", transaction.path("id").asString(), status);
                continue;
            }

            String transactionId = transaction.path("id").asString();
            String accountId = transaction.path("accountId").asString();

            assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
            assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");
            assertTrue(transaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

            long amount = transaction.path("amount").asLong();

            assertTrue(amount > 0, "Credit amount must be positive");

            jobs.add(new CreditJob(transactionId, accountId, amount, "PENDING".equals(status) ? 200 : 409));

            accountIds.add(accountId);
        }

        assertFalse(jobs.isEmpty(), "No PENDING or SUCCESS CREDIT transactions found");

        int concurrency = Math.min(10, jobs.size());

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(concurrency);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<CreditResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CreditResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (CreditJob job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var response = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new CreditResult(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<CreditResult> future : futures) {
                CreditResult result = future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                results.add(result);

                System.out.printf("Transaction=%s | Account=%s | Amount=%d | Status=%d | Body=%s%n", result.job().transactionId(), result.job().accountId(), result.job().amount(), result.actualStatus(), result.body());
            }

            long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 200).count();

            long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 409).count();

            System.out.printf("%nTotal=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n", results.size(), successCount, conflictCount, results.size() - successCount - conflictCount);

            for (String accountId : accountIds) {
                JsonNode balanceResponse = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

                assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

                System.out.printf("Final balance | Account=%s | Balance=%s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());
            }

            assertAll("Concurrent credit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().expectedStatus(), result.actualStatus(), "Unexpected response for transaction " + result.job().transactionId() + ": " + result.body())));
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
}

## Assistant

برای DEBIT بهتر است تست‌ها فقط status را چاپ نکنند؛ باید **موجودی نهایی، وضعیت تراکنش و تعداد برداشت‌های موفق** را هم بررسی کنند.

**نکته مهم درباره race:** ارسال همزمان درخواست‌ها با `CountDownLatch` احتمال رقابت را زیاد می‌کند، اما وقوع یک exception داخلی مثل deadlock یا duplicate key را تضمین نمی‌کند. اگر قفل‌گذاری درست باشد، ممکن است هیچ exception داخلی رخ ندهد؛ این رفتار مطلوب است. تست‌های زیر بررسی می‌کنند که **در حضور درخواست‌های رقیب، برداشت دوباره یا موجودی منفی اتفاق نیفتد**. بررسی قطعی اجرای retry نیاز به fault injection یا spy روی repository دارد و از پاسخ HTTP به‌تنهایی قابل اثبات نیست.

### پیش‌فرض‌های این کد

- موفقیت عملیات: `200`
- تراکنش تکراری یا idempotency conflict: `409`
- مبلغ نامعتبر: `400`
- موجودی ناکافی: `422`
- endpoint موجودی، مقدار عددی را در `explanation` برمی‌گرداند.
- خروجی لیست حساب‌ها شامل `id` و `username` است.

اگر exception handler پروژه status متفاوتی دارد، ثابت‌های ابتدای کلاس را مطابق آن تغییر بده.

کلاس زیر را کنار تست‌های فعلی اضافه کن. برای هر تست **حساب جدید و تراکنش‌های اختصاصی** ساخته می‌شود؛ بنابراین به ترتیب اجرای تست‌های CREDIT یا داده‌های قبلی وابسته نیست.

```java
package com.backend.serviceBalance;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.function.Executable;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class DebitIntegrationTests {

    private static final int OK = 200;
    private static final int BAD_REQUEST = 400;
    private static final int CONFLICT = 409;
    private static final int INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE = 422;

    private static final Duration DB_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(15);

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Autowired
    private R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private TransactionRepository transactionRepository;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    private record Job(
            String accountId,
            String transactionId,
            long amount
    ) {
    }

    private record Result(
            Job job,
            int status,
            String body
    ) {
    }

    @Test
    void debit_shouldDecreaseBalanceAndCompleteTransaction() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_equalToBalance_shouldLeaveZeroBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(0, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_zeroAndNegativeAmounts_shouldFailWithoutChangingBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        for (long amount : new long[]{0, -1, -10_000}) {
            Job job = new Job(accountId, newId(), amount);

            Result result = debit(job);

            assertEquals(BAD_REQUEST, result.status(), result.body());
            assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

            assertNull(
                    transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId())
                            .block(DB_TIMEOUT),
                    "Invalid amount must not create a transaction"
            );
        }
    }

    @Test
    void debit_moreThanBalance_shouldFailAndRollback() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        // این تراکنش از قبل وجود دارد؛ بعد از rollback باید PENDING بماند.
        Job existingTransaction = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_001);

        Result first = debit(existingTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, first.status(), first.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(
                existingTransaction,
                TransactionStatus.PENDING
        );

        // این تراکنش در debit ساخته می‌شود؛ insert آن هم باید rollback شود.
        Job newTransaction = new Job(accountId, newId(), 10_001);

        Result second = debit(newTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, second.status(), second.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

        assertNull(
                transactionRepository.findById(newTransaction.transactionId())
                        .block(DB_TIMEOUT),
                "New PENDING transaction must roll back on insufficient balance"
        );
    }

    @Test
    void debit_completedTransaction_shouldReturnConflictWithoutSecondWithdrawal() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Result first = debit(job);
        Result second = debit(job);

        assertAll(
                () -> assertEquals(OK, first.status(), first.body()),
                () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, second.status(), second.body()),
                () -> assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId)),
                () -> assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
        );
    }

    @Test

        assertEquals(
                0,
                balance(accountId),
                "A newly created test account must have zero balance"
        );

        String transactionId = insertPending(

                .uri(path("/balances/credit/"))

    private String createFreshAccount() {
        String unique = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        String username = "debit_test_" + unique;

                "%09d",

                .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .bodyValue(Map.of(

                        "username", username,
                        "email", username + "@example.com",
                        "phoneNumber", phoneNumber,
                        "status", "ACTIVE",

                .expectStatus().isCreated();

                .uri(path("/accounts/retrieve-accounts/"))

                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
                .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
                .returnResult()
                .getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts);
        assertTrue(accounts.isArray());

        for (JsonNode account : accounts) {
            if (username.equals(account.path("username").asString())) {
                String id = account.path("id").asString();

                assertFalse(id.isBlank());

                return id;
            }
        }

        throw new AssertionError(
                "Created account was not found: " + username
        );
```
