```java
    private Job pendingDebit(String accountId, long amount) {
        return new Job(
                accountId,
                insertPending(accountId, amount, TransactionMethod.DEBIT),
                amount
        );
    }

    private String insertPending(
            String accountId,
            long amount,
            TransactionMethod method
    ) {
        String transactionId = newId();
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder()
                .id(transactionId)
                .accountId(accountId)
                .amount(amount)
                .transactionMethod(method)
                .transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING)
                .createdAt(now)
                .updatedAt(now)
                .build();

        assertNotNull(entityTemplate.insert(transaction).block(DB_TIMEOUT));

        return transactionId;
    }

    private Result debit(Job job) {
        var response = client().post()
                .uri(path("/balances/debit/"))
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .bodyValue(Map.of(
                        "accountId", job.accountId(),
                        "transactionId", job.transactionId(),
                        "amount", job.amount()
                ))
                .exchange()
                .expectBody(String.class)
                .returnResult();

        return new Result(
                job,
                response.getStatus().value(),
                response.getResponseBody()
        );
    }

    private long balance(String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client().post()
                .uri(path("/balances/get-balance/"))
                .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                .bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId))
                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
                .expectBody(JsonNode.class)
                .returnResult()
                .getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"));

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private void assertTransactionStatus(
            Job job,
            TransactionStatus expected
    ) {
        Transaction transaction = transactionRepository
                .findById(job.transactionId())
                .block(DB_TIMEOUT);

        assertNotNull(
                transaction,
                "Transaction missing: " + job.transactionId()
        );

        assertEquals(expected, transaction.getTransactionStatus());
        assertEquals(job.accountId(), transaction.getAccountId());
        assertEquals(Long.valueOf(job.amount()), transaction.getAmount());
    }

    private List<Result> concurrently(List<Job> jobs) throws Exception {
        // تمام workerها باید همزمان به latch برسند؛
        // pool کوچک‌تر از jobs.size() با ready latch می‌تواند deadlock ایجاد کند.
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(jobs.size());

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(jobs.size());
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<Result>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Job job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException(
                                "Timed out waiting for concurrent start"
                        );
                    }

                    return debit(job);
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(
                    ready.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                    "Concurrent workers did not become ready"
            );

            start.countDown();

            List<Result> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Future<Result> future : futures) {
                // خطاهای worker مخفی نمی‌شوند؛ ExecutionException تست را fail می‌کند.
                results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
            }

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
    }

    private long countStatus(List<Result> results, int status) {
        return results.stream()
                .filter(result -> result.status() == status)
                .count();
    }

    private void assertNoUnexpectedStatus(
            List<Result> results,
            int firstAllowed,
            int secondAllowed
    ) {
        assertAll(
                "No unhandled concurrency errors",
                results.stream().<Executable>map(result -> () ->
                        assertTrue(
                                result.status() == firstAllowed
                                        || result.status() == secondAllowed,
                                "Unexpected response for "
                                        + result.job().transactionId()
                                        + ": status=" + result.status()
                                        + ", body=" + result.body()
                        )
                )
        );
    }

    private String describe(List<Result> results) {
        return results.toString();
    }
}
```

### این تست‌ها چه raceهایی را بررسی می‌کنند؟

| سناریو | انتظار قطعی |
|---|---|
| سه درخواست برای یک تراکنش `PENDING` | یک `200`، دو `409`، فقط یک برداشت |
| سه درخواست با transactionId جدید و مشترک | فقط یک ساخت و یک برداشت |
| ده تراکنش متفاوت روی یک حساب | موجودی دقیقاً به اندازه مجموع مبالغ کم شود |
| اجرای دوباره تراکنش‌های موفق | همه `409`، موجودی بدون تغییر |
| سه برداشت ۶۰۰۰ از موجودی ۱۰۰۰۰ | یک موفق، دو موجودی ناکافی، موجودی نهایی ۴۰۰۰ |
| یک transactionId با دو مبلغ متفاوت | فقط مبلغ مطابق تراکنش اجرا شود |

**برای تضمین تست خود retry** باید یک تست جدا داشته باشیم که repository در تلاش اول عمداً یک exception شناخته‌شده توسط `CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable` بدهد و در تلاش دوم موفق شود؛ سپس تعداد فراخوانی و موجودی نهایی assert شود. برای نوشتن دقیق آن، کد `CreditRetryPolicy` و امضای repositoryها لازم است—نباید یک exception دلخواه را «قابل retry» فرض کنیم.

همچنین این تست‌ها را روی **دیتابیس تست با همان نوع دیتابیس واقعی پروژه** اجرا کن؛ دیتابیس جایگزینی که رفتار `FOR UPDATE` متفاوت دارد، تضمین معتبر concurrency نمی‌دهد.

        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(accountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(method).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        assertNotNull(entityTemplate.insert(transaction).block(DB_TIMEOUT));

        return transactionId;
    }

    private Result debit(Job job) {
        var response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/debit/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

        return new Result(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
    }

    private long balance(String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/get-balance/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"));

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private void assertTransactionStatus(Job job, TransactionStatus expected) {
        Transaction transaction = transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT);

        assertNotNull(transaction, "Transaction missing: " + job.transactionId());

        assertEquals(expected, transaction.getTransactionStatus());
        assertEquals(job.accountId(), transaction.getAccountId());
        assertEquals(Long.valueOf(job.amount()), transaction.getAmount());
    }

    private List<Result> concurrently(List<Job> jobs) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(jobs.size());

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(jobs.size());
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<Result>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Job job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    return debit(job);
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Concurrent workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            List<Result> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Future<Result> future : futures) results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
    }

    private long countStatus(List<Result> results, int status) {
        return results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == status).count();
    }

    private void assertNoUnexpectedStatus(List<Result> results, int secondAllowed) {
        assertAll("No unhandled concurrency errors", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertTrue(result.status() == DebitIntegrationTests.OK || result.status() == secondAllowed, "Unexpected response for " + result.job().transactionId() + ": status=" + result.status() + ", body=" + result.body())));
    }

    private String describe(List<Result> results) {
        return results.toString();
    }
}

## ۳. کاهش موجودی چند اکانت به‌صورت concurrent

این متد را داخل همان کلاس اضافه کن. پنج اکانت ایجاد می‌کند و برای **هر اکانت چهار تراکنش** می‌سازد؛ سپس تمام ۲۰ برداشت را همزمان ارسال می‌کند. بنابراین هم رقابت روی یک حساب و هم اجرای همزمان حساب‌های مختلف بررسی می‌شود.

```java
@Test
void debit_multipleAccounts_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotals()
        throws Exception {

    int accountCount = 5;
    int transactionsPerAccount = 4;
    long initialBalance = 20_000;
    long debitAmount = 1_000;

    List<String> accountIds = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

    for (int i = 0; i < accountCount; i++) {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);
        accountIds.add(accountId);

        for (int j = 0; j < transactionsPerAccount; j++) {
            jobs.add(pendingDebit(accountId, debitAmount));
        }
    }

    // همه برداشت‌های همه حساب‌ها در یک batch همزمان اجرا می‌شوند.
    List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

    assertEquals(accountCount * transactionsPerAccount, results.size());

    assertAll(
            "Concurrent debit across multiple accounts",
            results.stream().map(result -> () ->
                    assertEquals(
                            OK,
                            result.status(),
                            "Account=" + result.job().accountId()
                                    + " | Transaction="
                                    + result.job().transactionId()
                                    + " | Body=" + result.body()
                    )
            )
    );

    long expectedBalance =
            initialBalance - transactionsPerAccount * debitAmount;

    for (String accountId : accountIds) {
        long actualBalance = balance(accountId);

        System.out.printf(
                "Account=%s | Expected balance=%d | Actual balance=%d%n",
                accountId,
                expectedBalance,
                actualBalance
        );

        assertEquals(
                expectedBalance,
                actualBalance,
                "Lost update or incorrect withdrawal for account " + accountId
        );
    }

    for (Job job : jobs) {
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    // اجرای تکراری همزمان نباید دوباره از هیچ حسابی برداشت کند.
    List<Result> repeatedResults = concurrently(jobs);

    assertAll(
            "Repeated transactions must return conflict",
            repeatedResults.stream().map(result -> () ->
                    assertEquals(
                            CONFLICT,
                            result.status(),
                            "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId()
                                    + " | Body=" + result.body()
                    )
            )
    );

    for (String accountId : accountIds) {
        assertEquals(
                expectedBalance,
                balance(accountId),
                "Repeated requests must not change balance: " + accountId
        );
    }
}
```

**دستور اجرا:**

```bash
./mvnw "-Dtest=DebitIntegrationTests#debit_multipleAccounts_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotals" test
```

انتظار: در دور اول ۲۰ پاسخ `200` و موجودی هر حساب `16000`؛ در دور دوم ۲۰ پاسخ `409` و موجودی‌ها بدون تغییر.

**نکته:** این سه دستور مستقل‌اند؛ تست‌های برداشت، حساب و تراکنش لازم را خودشان می‌سازند و از تراکنش ساخته‌شده در دستور اول استفاده نمی‌کنند. همچنین این‌ها صحت رفتار هنگام رقابت را بررسی می‌کنند، نه وقوع قطعی exception داخلی. روی دیتابیس تست اجرا کن، نه production.

package com.backend.serviceBalance;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class DebitIntegrationTests {

    private static final int OK = 200;
    private static final int BAD_REQUEST = 400;
    private static final int CONFLICT = 409;
    private static final int INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE = 422;
    private static final Duration DB_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(15);

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Autowired
    private R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;

    @Autowired
    private TransactionRepository transactionRepository;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    private record Job(String accountId, String transactionId, long amount) {
    }

    private record Result(Job job, int status, String body) {
    }

    @Test
    void debit_shouldDecreaseBalanceAndCompleteTransaction() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_equalToBalance_shouldLeaveZeroBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(0, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_zeroAndNegativeAmounts_shouldFailWithoutChangingBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        for (long amount : new long[]{0, -1, -10_000}) {
            Job job = new Job(accountId, newId(), amount);

            Result result = debit(job);

            assertEquals(BAD_REQUEST, result.status(), result.body());
            assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

            assertNull(transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT), "Invalid amount must not create a transaction");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void debit_moreThanBalance_shouldFailAndRollback() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job existingTransaction = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_001);

        Result first = debit(existingTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, first.status(), first.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(existingTransaction, TransactionStatus.PENDING);
        Job newTransaction = new Job(accountId, newId(), 10_001);

        Result second = debit(newTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, second.status(), second.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

        assertNull(transactionRepository.findById(newTransaction.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT), "New PENDING transaction must roll back on insufficient balance");
    }

    @Test
    void debit_completedTransaction_shouldReturnConflictWithoutSecondWithdrawal() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Result first = debit(job);
        Result second = debit(job);

        assertAll(() -> assertEquals(OK, first.status(), first.body()), () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, second.status(), second.body()), () -> assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId)), () -> assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS));
    }

    @Test
    void debit_sameTransactionWithDifferentAmount_shouldReturnConflict() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job original = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Job conflicting = new Job(accountId, original.transactionId(), 4_000);

        Result result = debit(conflicting);

        assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(original, TransactionStatus.PENDING);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_creditTransactionId_shouldReturnConflict() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        String transactionId = insertPending(accountId, 3_000, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);

        Job job = new Job(accountId, transactionId, 3_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_sameTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_shouldWithdrawExactlyOnce() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        List<Result> results = concurrently(List.of(job, job, job));

        assertAll("Same transaction race", () -> assertEquals(1, countStatus(results, OK), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(2, countStatus(results, CONFLICT), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId)), () -> assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS));

        assertNoUnexpectedStatus(results, CONFLICT);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_newTransactionId_concurrentRequests_shouldCreateAndWithdrawExactlyOnce() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = new Job(accountId, newId(), 3_000);

        List<Result> results = concurrently(List.of(job, job, job));

        assertAll("Concurrent creation of the same transaction", () -> assertEquals(1, countStatus(results, OK), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(2, countStatus(results, CONFLICT), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId)), () -> assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS));

        assertNoUnexpectedStatus(results, CONFLICT);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_allPendingTransactions_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotal() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(100_000);
        List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) jobs.add(pendingDebit(accountId, 1_000));

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Concurrent debit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(OK, result.status(), "Transaction " + result.job().transactionId() + ": " + result.body())));

        assertEquals(90_000, balance(accountId), "Concurrent debits must not lose balance updates");

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
        List<Result> repeated = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Completed debit transactions", repeated.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body())));

        assertEquals(90_000, balance(accountId));
    }

    @Test
    void debit_concurrentOverdraftRace_shouldAllowOnlyAffordableWithdrawals() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        List<Job> jobs = List.of(pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000), pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000), pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000));

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Overdraft race", () -> assertEquals(1, countStatus(results, OK), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(2, countStatus(results, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(4_000, balance(accountId), "Balance must never become negative or lose updates"));

        assertNoUnexpectedStatus(results, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE);

        for (Result result : results)
            assertTransactionStatus(result.job(), result.status() == OK ? TransactionStatus.SUCCESS : TransactionStatus.PENDING);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_conflictingAmountsRace_shouldOnlyExecuteMatchingOperation() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job valid = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Job invalid = new Job(accountId, valid.transactionId(), 4_000);

        List<Result> results = concurrently(List.of(valid, invalid));

        assertAll("Idempotency conflict race", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().amount() == 3_000 ? OK : CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body())));

        assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(valid, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    private String path(String suffix) {
        return baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "") + suffix;
    }

    private WebTestClient client() {
        return webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();
    }

    private String newId() {
        return UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    }

    private String fundedAccount(long initialBalance) {
        String accountId = createFreshAccount();

        assertEquals(0, balance(accountId), "A newly created test account must have zero balance");

        String transactionId = insertPending(accountId, initialBalance, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);

        var response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/credit/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", initialBalance)).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

        assertEquals(OK, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());

        assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId));

        return accountId;
    }

    private String createFreshAccount() {
        String unique = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        String username = "debit_test_" + unique;

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        client().post().uri(path("/accounts/create-account/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("firstname", "Debit", "lastname", "IntegrationTest", "username", username, "email", username + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1")).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated();

        JsonNode accounts = client().get().uri(path("/accounts/retrieve-accounts/")).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts);
        assertTrue(accounts.isArray());

        for (JsonNode account : accounts) {
            if (username.equals(account.path("username").asString())) {
                String id = account.path("id").asString();

                assertFalse(id.isBlank());

                return id;
            }
        }

        throw new AssertionError("Created account was not found: " + username);
    }

    private Job pendingDebit(String accountId, long amount) {
        return new Job(accountId, insertPending(accountId, amount, TransactionMethod.DEBIT), amount);
    }

    private String insertPending(String accountId, long amount, TransactionMethod method) {
        String transactionId = newId();
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(accountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(method).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        assertNotNull(entityTemplate.insert(transaction).block(DB_TIMEOUT));

        return transactionId;
    }

    private Result debit(Job job) {
        var response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/debit/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

        return new Result(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
    }

    private long balance(String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/get-balance/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"));

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private void assertTransactionStatus(Job job, TransactionStatus expected) {
        Transaction transaction = transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT);

        assertNotNull(transaction, "Transaction missing: " + job.transactionId());

        assertEquals(expected, transaction.getTransactionStatus());
        assertEquals(job.accountId(), transaction.getAccountId());
        assertEquals(Long.valueOf(job.amount()), transaction.getAmount());
    }

    private List<Result> concurrently(List<Job> jobs) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(jobs.size());

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(jobs.size());
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<Result>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Job job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    return debit(job);
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Concurrent workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            List<Result> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Future<Result> future : futures) results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
    }

    private long countStatus(List<Result> results, int status) {
        return results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == status).count();
    }

    private void assertNoUnexpectedStatus(List<Result> results, int secondAllowed) {
        assertAll("No unhandled concurrency errors", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertTrue(result.status() == DebitIntegrationTests.OK || result.status() == secondAllowed, "Unexpected response for " + result.job().transactionId() + ": status=" + result.status() + ", body=" + result.body())));
    }

    private String describe(List<Result> results) {
        return results.toString();
    }

    @Test
    void createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionMethod", TransactionMethod.DEBIT.name(), "amount", 3_000L);

        client().post().uri(path("/transactions/create-transaction/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");

        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId), "Creating a transaction must not withdraw money");
    }

    @Test
    void debit_multipleAccounts_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotals() throws Exception {

        int accountCount = 5;
        int transactionsPerAccount = 4;
        long initialBalance = 20_000;
        long debitAmount = 1_000;

        List<String> accountIds = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < accountCount; i++) {
            String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);
            accountIds.add(accountId);

            for (int j = 0; j < transactionsPerAccount; j++) jobs.add(pendingDebit(accountId, debitAmount));
        }

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertEquals(accountCount * transactionsPerAccount, results.size());

        assertAll("Concurrent debit across multiple accounts", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(OK, result.status(), "Account=" + result.job().accountId() + " | Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        long expectedBalance = initialBalance - transactionsPerAccount * debitAmount;

        for (String accountId : accountIds) {
            long actualBalance = balance(accountId);

            System.out.printf("Account=%s | Expected balance=%d | Actual balance=%d%n", accountId, expectedBalance, actualBalance);

            assertEquals(expectedBalance, actualBalance, "Lost update or incorrect withdrawal for account " + accountId);
        }

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);

        List<Result> repeatedResults = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Repeated transactions must return conflict", repeatedResults.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        for (String accountId : accountIds)
            assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId), "Repeated requests must not change balance: " + accountId);
    }
}

## ۱. این importها را اضافه کن

```java
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.util.Properties;
```

## ۲. این ثابت را داخل کلاس اضافه کن

فایل خارج از `target` قرار می‌گیرد تا با `mvn clean` پاک نشود:

```java
private static final Path DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE =
        Path.of(".test-data", "debit-single-account.properties");
```

## ۳. متد ساخت تراکنش را جایگزین کن

متد فعلی `createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated` را حذف و این را جایگزین کن:

```java
@Test
void createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated() throws Exception {
    assertFalse(
            Files.exists(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE),
            "Scenario already exists. Run the debit step, or delete "
                    + DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE + " to prepare a new scenario."
    );

    long initialBalance = 100_000;
    long amount = 1_000;
    int transactionCount = 10;

    String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);

    Properties scenario = new Properties();
    scenario.setProperty("accountId", accountId);
    scenario.setProperty("initialBalance", String.valueOf(initialBalance));
    scenario.setProperty("amount", String.valueOf(amount));
    scenario.setProperty("transactionCount", String.valueOf(transactionCount));

    for (int i = 0; i < transactionCount; i++) {
        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, amount);

        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);

        scenario.setProperty(
                "transactionId." + i,
                job.transactionId()
        );
    }

    assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId));

    Files.createDirectories(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.getParent());

    try (OutputStream output = Files.newOutputStream(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE)) {
        scenario.store(output, "Prepared single-account debit scenario");
    }

    System.out.printf(
            "Prepared account=%s | Balance=%d | Pending transactions=%d%n",
            accountId,
            initialBalance,
            transactionCount
    );

    System.out.println(
            "Scenario saved to: " + DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.toAbsolutePath()
    );
}
```

**نکته:** این نسخه تراکنش‌ها را با helper موجود `pendingDebit`، مستقیم در دیتابیس می‌سازد؛ تست endpoint ساخت تراکنش نیست. نام متد را فقط برای حفظ دستور قبلی نگه داشتیم.

### دستور اول: ساخت حساب، شارژ و آماده‌سازی تراکنش‌ها

```bash
./mvnw "-Dtest=DebitIntegrationTests#createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated" test
```

در این مرحله **هیچ برداشت DEBIT انجام نمی‌شود**؛ موجودی حساب `100000` می‌ماند.

## ۴. متد برداشت concurrent یک حساب را جایگزین کن

متد فعلی `debit_allPendingTransactions_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotal` را حذف و این را جایگزین کن:

```java
@Test
void debit_allPendingTransactions_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotal()
        throws Exception {

    assertTrue(
            Files.exists(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE),
            "First run createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated"
    );

    Properties scenario = new Properties();

    try (InputStream input = Files.newInputStream(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE)) {
        scenario.load(input);
    }

    String accountId = scenario.getProperty("accountId");

    long initialBalance = Long.parseLong(
            scenario.getProperty("initialBalance")
    );

    long amount = Long.parseLong(
            scenario.getProperty("amount")
    );

    int transactionCount = Integer.parseInt(
            scenario.getProperty("transactionCount")
    );

    List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

    for (int i = 0; i < transactionCount; i++) {
        jobs.add(new Job(
                accountId,
                scenario.getProperty("transactionId." + i),
                amount
        ));
    }

    // هیچ حساب، شارژ یا تراکنش جدیدی در این تست ایجاد نمی‌شود.
    assertEquals(
            initialBalance,
            balance(accountId),
            "Prepared account balance has changed, or debits already ran"
    );

    for (Job job : jobs) {
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);
    }

    List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

    assertAll(
            "Concurrent debit responses",
            results.stream().map(result -> () ->
                    assertEquals(
                            OK,
                            result.status(),
                            "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId()
                                    + " | Body=" + result.body()
                    )
            )
    );

    long expectedBalance = initialBalance - transactionCount * amount;

    assertEquals(
            expectedBalance,
            balance(accountId),
            "Concurrent debits must not lose balance updates"
    );

    for (Job job : jobs) {
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    // تکرار همان تراکنش‌ها نباید باعث برداشت مجدد شود.
    List<Result> repeated = concurrently(jobs);

    assertAll(
            "Repeated transactions",
            repeated.stream().map(result -> () ->
                    assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body())
            )
    );

    assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId));

    System.out.printf(
            "Debited SAME account=%s | Before=%d | After=%d%n",
            accountId,
            initialBalance,
            expectedBalance
    );
}
```

class DebitIntegrationTests {

    private static final int OK = 200;

    private static final Duration DB_TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(15);
    private static final Path DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE = Path.of(".test-data", "debit-single-account.properties");

    }

    }

    @Test
    void debit_shouldDecreaseBalanceAndCompleteTransaction() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Result result = debit(job);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    void debit_equalToBalance_shouldLeaveZeroBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_000);

        assertEquals(OK, result.status(), result.body());
        assertEquals(0, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_zeroAndNegativeAmounts_shouldFailWithoutChangingBalance() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        for (long amount : new long[]{0, -1, -10_000}) {
            Job job = new Job(accountId, newId(), amount);

            Result result = debit(job);

            assertEquals(BAD_REQUEST, result.status(), result.body());
            assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

            assertNull(transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT), "Invalid amount must not create a transaction");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void debit_moreThanBalance_shouldFailAndRollback() {
        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job existingTransaction = pendingDebit(accountId, 10_001);

        Result first = debit(existingTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, first.status(), first.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(existingTransaction, TransactionStatus.PENDING);
        Job newTransaction = new Job(accountId, newId(), 10_001);

        Result second = debit(newTransaction);

        assertEquals(INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, second.status(), second.body());
        assertEquals(10_000, balance(accountId));

        assertNull(transactionRepository.findById(newTransaction.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT), "New PENDING transaction must roll back on insufficient balance");
    }

    @Test
    void debit_allPendingTransactions_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotal() throws Exception {

        assertTrue(Files.exists(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE), "First run createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated");

        Properties scenario = new Properties();

        try (InputStream input = Files.newInputStream(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE)) {
            scenario.load(input);
        }

        String accountId = scenario.getProperty("accountId");

        long initialBalance = Long.parseLong(scenario.getProperty("initialBalance"));

        long amount = Long.parseLong(scenario.getProperty("amount"));

        int transactionCount = Integer.parseInt(scenario.getProperty("transactionCount"));

        List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < transactionCount; i++)
            jobs.add(new Job(accountId, scenario.getProperty("transactionId." + i), amount));

        assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId), "Prepared account balance has changed, or debits already ran");

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        for (int i = 0; i < results.size(); i++) {
            Result result = results.get(i);
            Job job = result.job();

            System.out.printf("Debit #%d -> account=%s, transaction=%s, amount=%d, status=%d, body=%s%n", i + 1, job.accountId(), job.transactionId(), job.amount(), result.status(), result.body());
        }

        assertAll("Concurrent debit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(OK, result.status(), "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        long expectedBalance = initialBalance - transactionCount * amount;

        assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId), "Concurrent debits must not lose balance updates");

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);

        List<Result> repeated = concurrently(jobs);

        for (int i = 0; i < repeated.size(); i++) {
            Result result = repeated.get(i);
            Job job = result.job();

            System.out.printf("Repeated Debit #%d -> account=%s, transaction=%s, amount=%d, status=%d, body=%s%n", i + 1, job.accountId(), job.transactionId(), job.amount(), result.status(), result.body());
        }

        assertAll("Repeated transactions", repeated.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body())));

        assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId));

        System.out.printf("Debited SAME account=%s | Before=%d | After=%d%n", accountId, initialBalance, expectedBalance);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_concurrentOverdraftRace_shouldAllowOnlyAffordableWithdrawals() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);

        List<Job> jobs = List.of(pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000), pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000), pendingDebit(accountId, 6_000));

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Overdraft race", () -> assertEquals(1, countStatus(results, OK), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(2, countStatus(results, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE), describe(results)), () -> assertEquals(4_000, balance(accountId), "Balance must never become negative or lose updates"));

        assertNoUnexpectedStatus(results, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE);

        for (Result result : results)
            assertTransactionStatus(result.job(), result.status() == OK ? TransactionStatus.SUCCESS : TransactionStatus.PENDING);
    }

    @Test
    void debit_conflictingAmountsRace_shouldOnlyExecuteMatchingOperation() throws Exception {

        String accountId = fundedAccount(10_000);
        Job valid = pendingDebit(accountId, 3_000);

        Job invalid = new Job(accountId, valid.transactionId(), 4_000);

        List<Result> results = concurrently(List.of(valid, invalid));

        assertAll("Idempotency conflict race", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().amount() == 3_000 ? OK : CONFLICT, result.status(), result.body())));

        assertEquals(7_000, balance(accountId));
        assertTransactionStatus(valid, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
    }

    private String path(String suffix) {
        return baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "") + suffix;
    }

    private WebTestClient client() {
        return webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();
    }

    private String newId() {
        return UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    }

    private String fundedAccount(long initialBalance) {
        String accountId = createFreshAccount();

        assertEquals(0, balance(accountId), "A newly created test account must have zero balance");

        String transactionId = insertPending(accountId, initialBalance, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);

        var response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/credit/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", initialBalance)).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

        assertEquals(OK, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());

        assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId));

        return accountId;
    }

    private String createFreshAccount() {
        String unique = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        String username = "debit_test_" + unique;

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        client().post().uri(path("/accounts/create-account/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("firstname", "Debit", "lastname", "IntegrationTest", "username", username, "email", username + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1")).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated();

        JsonNode accounts = client().get().uri(path("/accounts/retrieve-accounts/")).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts);
        assertTrue(accounts.isArray());

        for (JsonNode account : accounts) {
            if (username.equals(account.path("username").asString())) {
                String id = account.path("id").asString();

                assertFalse(id.isBlank());

                return id;
            }
        }

        throw new AssertionError("Created account was not found: " + username);
    }

    private Job pendingDebit(String accountId, long amount) {
        return new Job(accountId, insertPending(accountId, amount, TransactionMethod.DEBIT), amount);
    }

    private String insertPending(String accountId, long amount, TransactionMethod method) {
        String transactionId = newId();
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(accountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(method).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        assertNotNull(entityTemplate.insert(transaction).block(DB_TIMEOUT));

        return transactionId;
    }

    private Result debit(Job job) {
        var response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/debit/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

        return new Result(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
    }

    private long balance(String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client().post().uri(path("/balances/get-balance/")).contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response);
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"));

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private void assertTransactionStatus(Job job, TransactionStatus expected) {
        Transaction transaction = transactionRepository.findById(job.transactionId()).block(DB_TIMEOUT);

        assertNotNull(transaction, "Transaction missing: " + job.transactionId());

        assertEquals(expected, transaction.getTransactionStatus());
        assertEquals(job.accountId(), transaction.getAccountId());
        assertEquals(Long.valueOf(job.amount()), transaction.getAmount());
    }

    private List<Result> concurrently(List<Job> jobs) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(jobs.size());

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(jobs.size());
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<Result>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Job job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    return debit(job);
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Concurrent workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            List<Result> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Future<Result> future : futures) results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        }
    }

    private long countStatus(List<Result> results, int status) {
        return results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == status).count();
    }

    private void assertNoUnexpectedStatus(List<Result> results, int secondAllowed) {
        assertAll("No unhandled concurrency errors", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertTrue(result.status() == DebitIntegrationTests.OK || result.status() == secondAllowed, "Unexpected response for " + result.job().transactionId() + ": status=" + result.status() + ", body=" + result.body())));
    }

    private String describe(List<Result> results) {
        return results.toString();
    }

    @Test
    void createDebitTransaction_shouldReturnCreated() throws Exception {
        assertFalse(Files.exists(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE), "Scenario already exists. Run the debit step, or delete " + DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE + " to prepare a new scenario.");

        long initialBalance = 100_000;
        long amount = 1_000;
        int transactionCount = 10;

        String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);

        Properties scenario = new Properties();
        scenario.setProperty("accountId", accountId);
        scenario.setProperty("initialBalance", String.valueOf(initialBalance));
        scenario.setProperty("amount", String.valueOf(amount));
        scenario.setProperty("transactionCount", String.valueOf(transactionCount));

        for (int i = 0; i < transactionCount; i++) {
            Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, amount);

            assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);

            scenario.setProperty("transactionId." + i, job.transactionId());
        }

        assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId));

        Files.createDirectories(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.getParent());

        try (OutputStream output = Files.newOutputStream(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE)) {
            scenario.store(output, "Prepared single-account debit scenario");
        }

        System.out.printf("Prepared account=%s | Balance=%d | Pending transactions=%d%n", accountId, initialBalance, transactionCount);

        System.out.println("Scenario saved to: " + DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.toAbsolutePath());
    }

    @Test
    void debit_multipleAccounts_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotals() throws Exception {

        int accountCount = 5;
        int transactionsPerAccount = 4;
        long initialBalance = 20_000;
        long debitAmount = 1_000;

        List<String> accountIds = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < accountCount; i++) {
            String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);
            accountIds.add(accountId);

            for (int j = 0; j < transactionsPerAccount; j++) jobs.add(pendingDebit(accountId, debitAmount));
        }

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertEquals(accountCount * transactionsPerAccount, results.size());

        assertAll("Concurrent debit across multiple accounts", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(OK, result.status(), "Account=" + result.job().accountId() + " | Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        long expectedBalance = initialBalance - transactionsPerAccount * debitAmount;

        for (String accountId : accountIds) {
            long actualBalance = balance(accountId);

            System.out.printf("Account=%s | Expected balance=%d | Actual balance=%d%n", accountId, expectedBalance, actualBalance);

            assertEquals(expectedBalance, actualBalance, "Lost update or incorrect withdrawal for account " + accountId);
        }

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);

        List<Result> repeatedResults = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Repeated transactions must return conflict", repeatedResults.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        for (String accountId : accountIds)
            assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId), "Repeated requests must not change balance: " + accountId);
    }
}

    private List<Result> concurrently(List<Job> jobs) throws Exception {

        scenario.setProperty("transactionCount", String.valueOf(transactionCount));

        for (int i = 0; i < transactionCount; i++) {
            Job job = pendingDebit(accountId, amount);

            assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.PENDING);

            scenario.setProperty("transactionId." + i, job.transactionId());
        }

        assertEquals(initialBalance, balance(accountId));

        Files.createDirectories(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.getParent());

        try (OutputStream output = Files.newOutputStream(DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE)) {
            scenario.store(output, "Prepared single-account debit scenario");
        }

        System.out.printf("Prepared account=%s | Balance=%d | Pending transactions=%d%n", accountId, initialBalance, transactionCount);

        System.out.println("Scenario saved to: " + DEBIT_SCENARIO_FILE.toAbsolutePath());
    }

    @Test
    void debit_multipleAccounts_concurrently_shouldSubtractExactTotals() throws Exception {

        int accountCount = 5;
        int transactionsPerAccount = 4;
        long initialBalance = 20_000;
        long debitAmount = 1_000;

        List<String> accountIds = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Job> jobs = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < accountCount; i++) {
            String accountId = fundedAccount(initialBalance);
            accountIds.add(accountId);

            for (int j = 0; j < transactionsPerAccount; j++) jobs.add(pendingDebit(accountId, debitAmount));
        }

        List<Result> results = concurrently(jobs);

        assertEquals(accountCount * transactionsPerAccount, results.size());

        assertAll("Concurrent debit across multiple accounts", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(OK, result.status(), "Account=" + result.job().accountId() + " | Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        long expectedBalance = initialBalance - transactionsPerAccount * debitAmount;

        for (String accountId : accountIds) {
            long actualBalance = balance(accountId);

            System.out.printf("Account=%s | Expected balance=%d | Actual balance=%d%n", accountId, expectedBalance, actualBalance);

            assertEquals(expectedBalance, actualBalance, "Lost update or incorrect withdrawal for account " + accountId);
        }

        for (Job job : jobs) assertTransactionStatus(job, TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);

        List<Result> repeatedResults = concurrently(jobs);

        assertAll("Repeated transactions must return conflict", repeatedResults.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(CONFLICT, result.status(), "Transaction=" + result.job().transactionId() + " | Body=" + result.body())));

        for (String accountId : accountIds)
            assertEquals(expectedBalance, balance(accountId), "Repeated requests must not change balance: " + accountId);
    }
}

همه شرایطی که برای retry و concurrency در debit و credit هست اینجا هم باید باشه

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.InsufficientBalanceException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.TransactionAlreadyCompletedException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId, TransactionMethod transactionMethod) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(transactionMethod).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateDebit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> debitOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateDebit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {

        if (accountId == null || accountId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account ID is required");

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
    }

    private Mono<Void> debitOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.DEBIT))).flatMap(transaction -> processDebitTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> processDebitTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.DEBIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeDebit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be debited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeDebit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > currentBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(account.getId(), currentBalance, amount));

            account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.error(new UnsupportedOperationException("Transfer is not implemented yet"));
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}
