## Assistant

برای `transfer` باید **کسر از مبدأ، افزایش موجودی مقصد و موفق‌شدن تراکنش، همگی در یک تراکنش دیتابیس** انجام شوند. بنابراین نباید متدهای `debit()` و `credit()` را جداگانه صدا بزنیم.

برای جلوگیری از deadlock در انتقال‌های همزمان مثل `A → B` و `B → A`، دو حساب را **همیشه با ترتیب ثابت شناسه‌ها** قفل می‌کنیم.

## ۱. تغییر لازم در مدل Transaction

برای تشخیص درخواست تکراری، باید مقصد هم در تراکنش ذخیره شود؛ بررسی فقط مبدأ و مبلغ کافی نیست.

کد زیر فرض می‌کند:

- در `TransactionMethod` مقدار `TRANSFER` اضافه شده است.
- مدل `Transaction` فیلدی به نام `destinationAccountId` دارد، همراه getter و builder.
- ستون مربوطه در دیتابیس اضافه شده است.
- فیلد فعلی `accountId` برای انتقال، **حساب مبدأ** است.

مثلاً در مدل:

```java
// accountId فعلی، حساب مبدأ انتقال است.

private String destinationAccountId;
```

اگر mapping خودکار snake_case فعال است، ستون آن `destination_account_id` خواهد بود. نوع ستون را مطابق نوع ستون فعلی `account_id` در migration انتخاب کن. اگر دیتابیس روی مقادیر `transactionMethod` محدودیت یا enum دارد، آن را هم برای `TRANSFER` به‌روزرسانی کن.

## ۲. پیاده‌سازی transfer

متد فعلی `transfer` را جایگزین کن و متدهای کمکی زیر را به `BalanceServiceImpl` اضافه کن:

```java
@Override
public Mono<Void> transfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        validateTransfer(
                sourceAccountId,
                destinationAccountId,
                amount,
                transactionId
        );

        return Mono.defer(() -> transferOnce(
                        sourceAccountId,
                        destinationAccountId,
                        amount,
                        transactionId
                ))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout))
                .retryWhen(
                        Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200))
                                .maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2))
                                .jitter(0.5)
                                .filter(error ->
                                        !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException)
                                        && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException)
                                        && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException)
                                        && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException)
                                        && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)
                                )
                                .onRetryExhaustedThrow(
                                        (spec, signal) -> signal.failure()
                                )
                )
                .transformDeferred(
                        CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker)
                );
    });
}

private void validateTransfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    if (sourceAccountId == null || sourceAccountId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source account ID is required");
    }

    if (destinationAccountId == null || destinationAccountId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Destination account ID is required");
    }

    if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");
    }

    if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
    }

    if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Source and destination accounts must be different"
        );
    }
}

private Mono<Void> transferOnce(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        boolean sourceFirst =
                sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

        String firstId = sourceFirst
                ? sourceAccountId
                : destinationAccountId;

        String secondId = sourceFirst
                ? destinationAccountId
                : sourceAccountId;

        // Sequential locking: do not use Mono.zip here.
        Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId)
                .flatMap(first ->
                        lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId)
                                .flatMap(second -> {
                                    Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;
                                    Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                                    return transactionRepository
                                            .findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
                                            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                                                    createPendingTransfer(
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            ))
                                            .flatMap(transaction ->
                                                    processTransferTransaction(
                                                            source,
                                                            destination,
                                                            transaction,
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            );
                                })
                )
                .then();

        return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
    });
}

private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(
        String accountId,
        String sourceAccountId
) {
    String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId)
            ? "Source"
            : "Destination";

    return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId)
            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    role + " account not found: " + accountId
            )));
}

private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

    Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder()
            .id(transactionId)
            .accountId(sourceAccountId)
            .destinationAccountId(destinationAccountId)
            .amount(amount)
            .transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.TRANSFER)
            .transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            .createdAt(now)
            .updatedAt(now)
            .build();

    return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
}

private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        Transaction transaction,
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAccountId(), sourceAccountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getDestinationAccountId(), destinationAccountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAmount(), amount
            )
            && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.TRANSFER;

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        return Mono.error(
                new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                "Transaction cannot be transferred in status "
                        + status + ": " + transactionId
        ));
    }

    return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
}

private Mono<Transaction> completeTransfer(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        Transaction transaction
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
        Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
        Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

        if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Source account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Destination account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Amount must be greater than zero"
            ));
        }

        if (amount > sourceBalance) {
            return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(
                    source.getId(),
                    sourceBalance,
                    amount
            ));
        }

        final long newDestinationBalance;

        try {
            newDestinationBalance = Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
        } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Destination balance exceeds the supported range",
                    exception
            ));
        }

        source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
        destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

        return accountRepository.save(source)
                .then(accountRepository.save(destination))
                .then(Mono.defer(() -> {
                    transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                    transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                    return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
                }));
    });
}
```

## ۳. نکات ضروری برای retry و concurrency

این پیاده‌سازی رفتار فعلی `debit` و `credit` را حفظ می‌کند:

| وضعیت | رفتار |
|---|---|
| مبدأ یا مقصد خالی یا ناموجود | خطای اعتبارسنجی |
| مبلغ `null` یا `<= 0` | خطای اعتبارسنجی |
| موجودی ناکافی | `InsufficientBalanceException` و rollback |
| مقصد با موجودی خارج از محدوده `long` | خطا و rollback |
| همان شناسه با مبدأ، مقصد، مبلغ یا روش متفاوت | `IdempotencyConflictException` |
| درخواست تکراری تراکنش موفق | `TransactionAlreadyCompletedException`، بدون انتقال مجدد |
| چند انتقال همزمان از یک حساب | سریال‌شدن تغییرات با قفل حساب |
| انتقال‌های معکوس همزمان | ترتیب ثابت قفل حساب‌ها برای جلوگیری از deadlock ناشی از ترتیب معکوس |
| خطای موقتی قابل retry | اجرای مجدد **کل تراکنش** |

**سه شرط زیر را در تنظیمات فعلی بررسی کن:**

1. `findByIdForUpdate` واقعاً از `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` استفاده کند و `transactionId` در دیتابیس `PRIMARY KEY` یا `UNIQUE` باشد.
2. `TransactionalOperator` و repositoryها از همان دیتابیس و transaction manager استفاده کنند.
3. در `CreditRetryPolicy` برخورد همزمان روی درج یک **شناسه تراکنش جدید** پوشش داده شده باشد. وقتی حساب‌های دو درخواست متفاوت‌اند اما `transactionId` یکی است، قفل حساب‌ها کافی نیست و ممکن است درج با unique violation شکست بخورد. فقط برخورد روی قید شناسه تراکنش را برای این حالت retry کن، نه هر خطای integrity را.

همچنین فعلاً مطابق کد موجود از `creditCircuitBreaker` استفاده شده است؛ در تنظیمات آن بهتر است خطاهای کسب‌وکار مثل موجودی ناکافی و conflict در شمارش شکست‌های circuit breaker لحاظ نشوند.

**نکته:** timeout لزوماً به معنی انجام‌نشدن انتقال نیست؛ ممکن است commit انجام شده ولی پاسخ نرسیده باشد. کلاینت باید retry را با **همان `transactionId`** انجام دهد، نه شناسه جدید.

دلیلی نداره تراکنش بخواد destination_account_id بگیره همون sourceAccountId کافیه

و اینکه اگر مبدا و مقصد یکی بود باید خطا بده

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.InsufficientBalanceException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.TransactionAlreadyCompletedException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId, TransactionMethod transactionMethod) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(transactionMethod).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateDebit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> debitOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateDebit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {

        if (accountId == null || accountId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account ID is required");

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
    }

    private Mono<Void> debitOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.DEBIT))).flatMap(transaction -> processDebitTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> processDebitTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.DEBIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeDebit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be debited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeDebit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > currentBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(account.getId(), currentBalance, amount));

            account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> transferOnce(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((spec, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        if (sourceAccountId == null || sourceAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source account ID is required");
        }

        if (destinationAccountId == null || destinationAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Destination account ID is required");
        }

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
        }

        if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source and destination accounts must be different");
        }
    }

    private Mono<Void> transferOnce(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            boolean sourceFirst = sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

            String firstId = sourceFirst ? sourceAccountId : destinationAccountId;

            String secondId = sourceFirst ? destinationAccountId : sourceAccountId;

            // Sequential locking: do not use Mono.zip here.
            Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(first -> lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(second -> {
                Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;
                Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                return transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processTransferTransaction(source, destination, transaction, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId));
            })).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(String accountId, String sourceAccountId) {
        String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId) ? "Source" : "Destination";

        return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(role + " account not found: " + accountId)));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(sourceAccountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.TRANSFER).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction, String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), sourceAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getDestinationAccountId(), destinationAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.TRANSFER;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be transferred in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));

        return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeTransfer(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
            Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Source account balance is invalid"));

            if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Destination account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > sourceBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(source.getId(), sourceBalance, amount));

            final long newDestinationBalance;

            try {
                newDestinationBalance = Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Destination balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
            destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(source).then(accountRepository.save(destination)).then(Mono.defer(() -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            }));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

## Assistant

می‌توانی `Transaction` را بدون `destinationAccountId` نگه داری و فقط مبدأ را در `accountId` ذخیره کنی؛ **اما در این طراحی، تغییر مقصد با همان `transactionId` قابل تشخیص نیست**. یعنی جلوگیری از انتقال مجدد برقرار است، ولی بررسی یکسان‌بودن درخواست فقط بر اساس **مبدأ، مبلغ و نوع عملیات** انجام می‌شود.

در کد فعلی، مقصد را ذخیره نمی‌کنی ولی در `sameOperation` آن را بررسی می‌کنی؛ اگر فیلد وجود نداشته باشد کد کامپایل نمی‌شود و اگر وجود داشته ولی `null` باشد، انتقال همیشه conflict می‌دهد.

### ۱. اصلاح بخش داخل `transferOnce`

این قسمت را:

```java
return transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
        .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                createPendingTransfer(
                        sourceAccountId,
                        destinationAccountId,
                        amount,
                        transactionId
                )
        ))
        .flatMap(transaction ->
                processTransferTransaction(
                        source,
                        destination,
                        transaction,
                        sourceAccountId,
                        destinationAccountId,
                        amount,
                        transactionId
                )
        );
```

با این جایگزین کن؛ از متد موجود `createPendingTransaction` هم استفاده می‌کنیم:

```java
return transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
        .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                createPendingTransaction(
                        sourceAccountId,
                        amount,
                        transactionId,
                        TransactionMethod.TRANSFER
                )
        ))
        .flatMap(transaction ->
                processTransferTransaction(
                        source,
                        destination,
                        transaction,
                        sourceAccountId,
                        amount,
                        transactionId
                )
        );
```

پس متد `createPendingTransfer` را کامل حذف کن؛ دیگر لازم نیست.

### ۲. اصلاح `processTransferTransaction`

```java
private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        Transaction transaction,
        String sourceAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAccountId(),
                    sourceAccountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAmount(),
                    amount
            )
            && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.TRANSFER;

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(
                new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        return Mono.error(
                new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                "Transaction cannot be transferred in status "
                        + status + ": " + transactionId
        ));
    }

    return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
}
```

### ۳. مبدأ و مقصد یکسان

این شرط **همین حالا در `validateTransfer` درست پیاده‌سازی شده** و قبل از دسترسی به دیتابیس خطا می‌دهد:

```java
if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
            "Source and destination accounts must be different"
    );
}
```

اگر exception handler فعلی، `IllegalArgumentException` را به `400 Bad Request` نگاشت کرده باشد، این حالت هم پاسخ `400` می‌گیرد.

بقیه کد انتقال، شامل قفل‌کردن مرتب حساب‌ها، بررسی موجودی، rollback و retry، بدون تغییر باقی می‌ماند.

**محدودیت مهم این انتخاب:** اگر تراکنش `PENDING` باشد و دو درخواست با مبدأ، مبلغ و شناسه یکسان ولی مقصد متفاوت برسند، هرکدام زودتر اجرا شود مقصد انتقال را تعیین می‌کند. برای تشخیص این اختلاف، باید مقصد یا fingerprint درخواست در یک محل پایدار ذخیره شود؛ صرفاً `sourceAccountId` این اطلاعات را ندارد.

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > currentBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(account.getId(), currentBalance, amount));

            account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> transferOnce(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((spec, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        if (sourceAccountId == null || sourceAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source account ID is required");
        }

        if (destinationAccountId == null || destinationAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Destination account ID is required");
        }

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
        }

        if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source and destination accounts must be different");
        }
    }

    private Mono<Void> transferOnce(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            boolean sourceFirst = sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

            String firstId = sourceFirst ? sourceAccountId : destinationAccountId;

            String secondId = sourceFirst ? destinationAccountId : sourceAccountId;

            // Sequential locking: do not use Mono.zip here.
            Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(first -> lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(second -> {
                Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;
                Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                return transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processTransferTransaction(source, destination, transaction, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId));
            })).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(String accountId, String sourceAccountId) {
        String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId) ? "Source" : "Destination";

        return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(role + " account not found: " + accountId)));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(sourceAccountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.TRANSFER).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction, String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), sourceAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getDestinationAccountId(), destinationAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.TRANSFER;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be transferred in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));

        return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeTransfer(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
            Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Source account balance is invalid"));

            if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Destination account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > sourceBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(source.getId(), sourceBalance, amount));

            final long newDestinationBalance;

            try {
                newDestinationBalance = Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Destination balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
            destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(source).then(accountRepository.save(destination)).then(Mono.defer(() -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            }));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

## Assistant

بله، مدل مستقل `TransferTransaction` انتخاب مناسبی است: مبدأ و مقصد هر دو اجباری می‌شوند و مدل فعلی `Transaction` برای `credit` و `debit` دست‌نخورده می‌ماند.

البته `null` برای فیلدی که به یک نوع عملیات مربوط نیست، ذاتاً داده کثیف نیست؛ ولی تفکیک مدل‌ها در اینجا ساختار روشن‌تری می‌دهد.

در این پیاده‌سازی، **شناسه انتقال در جدول انتقال‌ها یکتا است**. یعنی فضای شناسه‌های transfer از credit/debit مستقل خواهد بود. اگر `transactionId` باید بین همه عملیات globally unique باشد، به یک جدول مشترک ثبت شناسه عملیات نیاز داریم؛ بررسی ساده دو جدول، در concurrency کافی نیست.

## ۱. مدل `TransferTransaction`

اینجا `transactionMethod` لازم نیست؛ همه رکوردهای این جدول، انتقال هستند.

## ۲. Repository

کد زیر با فرض دیتابیسی نوشته شده که `FOR UPDATE` را پشتیبانی می‌کند، مثل PostgreSQL:

## ۳. تغییرات `BalanceServiceImpl`

این importها را اضافه کن:

```java
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.TransferTransaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransferTransactionRepository;
```

این dependency را هم اضافه کن؛ `@RequiredArgsConstructor` آن را تزریق می‌کند:

```java
private final TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository;
```

متدهای فعلی `transfer()`، `validateTransfer()` و `lockTransferAccount()` را نگه دار. شرط خطای مبدأ و مقصد یکسان در `validateTransfer()` از قبل درست است.

**چهار متد زیر را جایگزین نسخه فعلی کن:**

### `transferOnce`

```java
private Mono<Void> transferOnce(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        // Always lock accounts in the same order.
        boolean sourceFirst =
                sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

        String firstId = sourceFirst
                ? sourceAccountId
                : destinationAccountId;

        String secondId = sourceFirst
                ? destinationAccountId
                : sourceAccountId;

        Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId)
                .flatMap(first ->
                        lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId)
                                .flatMap(second -> {
                                    Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;
                                    Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                                    return transferTransactionRepository
                                            .findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
                                            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                                                    createPendingTransfer(
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            ))
                                            .flatMap(transaction ->
                                                    processTransferTransaction(
                                                            source,
                                                            destination,
                                                            transaction,
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            );
                                })
                )
                .then();

        return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
    });
}
```

### `createPendingTransfer`

برای شناسه‌ای که خودمان تعیین می‌کنیم، مثل کد فعلی از `entityTemplate.insert()` استفاده می‌کنیم:

```java
private Mono<TransferTransaction> createPendingTransfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

    TransferTransaction transaction = TransferTransaction.builder()
            .id(transactionId)
            .sourceAccountId(sourceAccountId)
            .destinationAccountId(destinationAccountId)
            .amount(amount)
            .transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            .createdAt(now)
            .updatedAt(now)
            .build();

    return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
}
```

### `processTransferTransaction`

حالا یکسان‌بودن **مبدأ، مقصد و مبلغ** بررسی می‌شود:

```java
private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        TransferTransaction transaction,
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getSourceAccountId(),
                    sourceAccountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getDestinationAccountId(),
                    destinationAccountId
            )
            && java.util.Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAmount(),
                    amount
            );

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(
                new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        return Mono.error(
                new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                "Transaction cannot be transferred in status "
                        + status + ": " + transactionId
        ));
    }

    return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
}
```

### `completeTransfer`

```java
private Mono<TransferTransaction> completeTransfer(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        TransferTransaction transaction
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
        Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
        Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

        if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Source account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Destination account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Amount must be greater than zero"
            ));
        }

        if (amount > sourceBalance) {
            return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(
                    source.getId(),
                    sourceBalance,
                    amount
            ));
        }

        final long newDestinationBalance;

        try {
            newDestinationBalance =
                    Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
        } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Destination balance exceeds the supported range",
                    exception
            ));
        }

        source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
        destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

        return accountRepository.save(source)
                .then(accountRepository.save(destination))
                .then(Mono.defer(() -> {
                    transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                    transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                    return transferTransactionRepository.save(transaction);
                }));
    });
}
```

## ۴. جدول دیتابیس

نمونه migration برای PostgreSQL؛ **نوع و نام جدول حساب‌ها را با schema خودت تطبیق بده**:

```sql
CREATE TABLE transfer_transactions (
    id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    source_account_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    destination_account_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    amount BIGINT NOT NULL,
    transaction_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT chk_transfer_amount_positive
        CHECK (amount > 0),

    CONSTRAINT chk_transfer_distinct_accounts
        CHECK (source_account_id <> destination_account_id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_transfer_source_account
        FOREIGN KEY (source_account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id),

    CONSTRAINT fk_transfer_destination_account
        FOREIGN KEY (destination_account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id)
);
```

`@NotNull` و `@Positive` به‌تنهایی تضمین نمی‌کنند هنگام ذخیره از طریق R2DBC اعتبارسنجی اجرا شود؛ برای همین validation سرویس و constraint دیتابیس را نگه می‌داریم.

## نکته ضروری retry

**`FOR UPDATE` رکورد ناموجود را قفل نمی‌کند.** پس اگر دو درخواست با `transactionId` یکسان ولی حساب‌های متفاوت برسند، ممکن است هر دو بخواهند رکورد انتقال را درج کنند.

کلید اصلی جدول مانع درج دوباره می‌شود، اما برای اینکه درخواست بازنده پس از rollback دوباره اجرا شود و به `IdempotencyConflictException` یا `TransactionAlreadyCompletedException` برسد، باید `CreditRetryPolicy` برخورد unique روی **کلید اصلی `transfer_transactions`** را قابل retry بداند. بدون دیدن پیاده‌سازی آن policy، نمی‌توان تضمین کرد این حالت اکنون پوشش داده شده است.

در نهایت، کسر مبدأ، افزایش مقصد و تغییر وضعیت انتقال، همگی داخل همان `TransactionalOperator` هستند؛ بنابراین با خطای هر مرحله، **تمام تغییرات rollback می‌شوند**، به شرط اینکه repositoryها و `entityTemplate` از همان transaction manager و اتصال دیتابیس استفاده کنند.

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.InsufficientBalanceException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.TransactionAlreadyCompletedException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId, TransactionMethod transactionMethod) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(transactionMethod).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateDebit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> debitOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateDebit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {

        if (accountId == null || accountId.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Account ID is required");

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank())
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
    }

    private Mono<Void> debitOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.DEBIT))).flatMap(transaction -> processDebitTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> processDebitTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.DEBIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeDebit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be debited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeDebit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > currentBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(account.getId(), currentBalance, amount));

            account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            validateTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> transferOnce(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((spec, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private void validateTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        if (sourceAccountId == null || sourceAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source account ID is required");
        }

        if (destinationAccountId == null || destinationAccountId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Destination account ID is required");
        }

        if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Transaction ID is required");
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero");
        }

        if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source and destination accounts must be different");
        }
    }

    private Mono<Void> transferOnce(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            boolean sourceFirst = sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

            String firstId = sourceFirst ? sourceAccountId : destinationAccountId;

            String secondId = sourceFirst ? destinationAccountId : sourceAccountId;

            // Sequential locking: do not use Mono.zip here.
            Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(first -> lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(second -> {
                Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;
                Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                return transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processTransferTransaction(source, destination, transaction, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId));
            })).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(String accountId, String sourceAccountId) {
        String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId) ? "Source" : "Destination";

        return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(role + " account not found: " + accountId)));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).accountId(sourceAccountId).amount(amount).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.TRANSFER).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction, String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), sourceAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getDestinationAccountId(), destinationAccountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.TRANSFER;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be transferred in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));

        return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction).then();
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeTransfer(Account source, Account destination, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
            Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Source account balance is invalid"));

            if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Destination account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > sourceBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(source.getId(), sourceBalance, amount));

            final long newDestinationBalance;

            try {
                newDestinationBalance = Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Destination balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
            destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(source).then(accountRepository.save(destination)).then(Mono.defer(() -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            }));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}
