## ۲. جایگزینی بخش انتقال در سرویس

متدهای `transfer` تا `completeTransfer` فعلی را با کد زیر جایگزین کن:

```java
@Override
public Mono<Void> transfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        validateTransfer(
                sourceAccountId,
                destinationAccountId,
                amount,
                transactionId
        );

        return Mono.defer(() ->
                        transferOnce(
                                sourceAccountId,
                                destinationAccountId,
                                amount,
                                transactionId
                        )
                )
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout))
                .retryWhen(
                        Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200))
                                .maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2))
                                .jitter(0.5)
                                .filter(error ->
                                        !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException)
                                        && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException)
                                        && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException)
                                        && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException)
                                        && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)
                                )
                                .onRetryExhaustedThrow(
                                        (spec, signal) -> signal.failure()
                                )
                )
                .transformDeferred(
                        CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker)
                );
    });
}

private void validateTransfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    if (sourceAccountId == null || sourceAccountId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Source account ID is required"
        );
    }

    if (destinationAccountId == null || destinationAccountId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Destination account ID is required"
        );
    }

    if (transactionId == null || transactionId.isBlank()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Transaction ID is required"
        );
    }

    if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Amount must be greater than zero"
        );
    }

    if (sourceAccountId.equals(destinationAccountId)) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "Source and destination accounts must be different"
        );
    }
}

private Mono<Void> transferOnce(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        boolean sourceFirst =
                sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

        String firstId = sourceFirst
                ? sourceAccountId
                : destinationAccountId;

        String secondId = sourceFirst
                ? destinationAccountId
                : sourceAccountId;

        // Sequential locking in a consistent order.
        Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId)
                .flatMap(first ->
                        lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId)
                                .flatMap(second -> {
                                    Account source =
                                            sourceFirst ? first : second;

                                    Account destination =
                                            sourceFirst ? second : first;

                                    return transferTransactionRepository
                                            .findByIdForUpdate(transactionId)
                                            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() ->
                                                    createPendingTransfer(
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            ))
                                            .flatMap(transaction ->
                                                    processTransferTransaction(
                                                            source,
                                                            destination,
                                                            transaction,
                                                            sourceAccountId,
                                                            destinationAccountId,
                                                            amount,
                                                            transactionId
                                                    )
                                            );
                                })
                )
                .then();

        return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
    });
}

private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(
        String accountId,
        String sourceAccountId
) {
    String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId)
            ? "Source"
            : "Destination";

    return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId)
            .switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    role + " account not found: " + accountId
            )));
}

private Mono<TransferTransaction> createPendingTransfer(
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

    TransferTransaction transaction = TransferTransaction.builder()
            .id(transactionId)
            .sourceAccountId(sourceAccountId)
            .destinationAccountId(destinationAccountId)
            .amount(amount)
            .transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            .createdAt(now)
            .updatedAt(now)
            .build();

    return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
}

private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        TransferTransaction transaction,
        String sourceAccountId,
        String destinationAccountId,
        Long amount,
        String transactionId
) {
    boolean sameOperation =
            Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getSourceAccountId(),
                    sourceAccountId
            )
            && Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getDestinationAccountId(),
                    destinationAccountId
            )
            && Objects.equals(
                    transaction.getAmount(),
                    amount
            );

    if (!sameOperation) {
        return Mono.error(
                new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

    if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS) {
        return Mono.error(
                new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId)
        );
    }

    if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING) {
        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                "Transaction cannot be transferred in status "
                        + status + ": " + transactionId
        ));
    }

    return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction);
}

private Mono<Void> completeTransfer(
        Account source,
        Account destination,
        TransferTransaction transaction
) {
    return Mono.defer(() -> {
        Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
        Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
        Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

        if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Source account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException(
                    "Destination account balance is invalid"
            ));
        }

        if (amount == null || amount <= 0) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Amount must be greater than zero"
            ));
        }

        if (amount > sourceBalance) {
            return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(
                    source.getId(),
                    sourceBalance,
                    amount
            ));
        }

        final long newDestinationBalance;

        try {
            newDestinationBalance =
                    Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
        } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
            return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Destination balance exceeds the supported range",
                    exception
            ));
        }

        source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
        destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

        return accountRepository.save(source)
                .then(accountRepository.save(destination))
                .then(Mono.defer(() ->
                        transferTransactionRepository
                                .updateTransferTransactionStatus(
                                        transaction.getId(),
                                        TransactionStatus.SUCCESS
                                )
                ))
                .flatMap(updatedRows -> {
                    if (updatedRows != 1) {
                        return Mono.<Void>error(
                                new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Expected to update one transfer transaction, "
                                                + "but updated " + updatedRows
                                                + ": " + transaction.getId()
                                )
                        );
                    }

                    return Mono.<Void>empty();
                });
    });
}
```

بررسی `updatedRows` مهم است: اگر رکورد وضعیت به‌روزرسانی نشود، خطا ایجاد می‌شود تا تغییر موجودی‌ها هم در همان تراکنش rollback شوند.

## ۳. اصلاح `updated_at` در repository

امضای متد فعلی را نگه دار و فقط query را این‌طور تغییر بده:

```java
@Modifying
@Query("""
        UPDATE transfer_transactions
        SET transaction_status = :status,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = :id
        """)
Mono<Integer> updateTransferTransactionStatus(
        @Param("id") String id,
        @Param("status") TransactionStatus status
);
```

با این تغییر، نیازی به `setUpdatedAt()` در سرویس نیست؛ timestamp مستقیماً در دیتابیس تغییر می‌کند.

### نتیجه

- `TransactionRepository` فقط برای `credit` و `debit` استفاده می‌شود.
- انتقال‌ها در `transfer_transactions` ثبت می‌شوند.
- درخواست با مبدأ و مقصد یکسان، قبل از دسترسی به دیتابیس خطا می‌گیرد.
- تغییر مبدأ، مقصد یا مبلغ با همان شناسه انتقال، conflict می‌دهد.
- دو موجودی و وضعیت انتقال در یک تراکنش دیتابیس تغییر می‌کنند.

**نکته concurrency:** کلید اصلی `transfer_transactions.id` باید یکتا باشد. `FOR UPDATE` رکورد ناموجود را قفل نمی‌کند؛ بنابراین برخورد هم‌زمان هنگام درج همان شناسه همچنان باید در `CreditRetryPolicy` مدیریت شود. همچنین در این طراحی، یکتایی شناسه انتقال مستقل از جدول `transactions` است.

```sql
        DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

    source_account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
```

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.models.Account;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.IdempotencyConflictException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.InsufficientBalanceException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.exceptions.TransactionAlreadyCompletedException;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.validators.BalanceValidator;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.configs.CreditRetryPolicy;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.TransferTransaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransferTransactionRepository;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.data.r2dbc.core.R2dbcEntityTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.reactive.TransactionalOperator;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.util.retry.Retry;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Objects;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class BalanceServiceImpl implements BalanceService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransactionRepository transactionRepository;
    private final R2dbcEntityTemplate entityTemplate;
    private final TransactionalOperator transactionalOperator;
    private final BalanceValidator balanceValidator;
    private final CircuitBreaker creditCircuitBreaker;
    private final TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository;

    @Value("${max-retry}")
    private Long maxRetry;

    @Value("${max-duration-timeout}")
    private Long maxDurationTimeout;

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> credit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateCredit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> creditOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> creditOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processCreditTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.CREDIT);
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> createPendingTransaction(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId, TransactionMethod transactionMethod) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        Transaction transaction = Transaction.builder().id(transactionId).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).transactionMethod(transactionMethod).amount(amount).accountId(accountId).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processCreditTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.CREDIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeCredit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be credited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeCredit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            final long newBalance;

            try {
                newBalance = Math.addExact(currentBalance, transaction.getAmount());
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            account.setBalance(newBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> debit(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateDebit(accountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> debitOnce(accountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> debitOnce(String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Mono<Void> work = accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found: " + accountId))).flatMap(account -> transactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransaction(accountId, amount, transactionId, TransactionMethod.DEBIT))).flatMap(transaction -> processDebitTransaction(account, transaction, accountId, amount, transactionId))).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> processDebitTransaction(Account account, Transaction transaction, String accountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAccountId(), accountId) && java.util.Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount) && transaction.getTransactionMethod() == TransactionMethod.DEBIT;

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status == TransactionStatus.PENDING) return completeDebit(account, transaction).then();

        return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be debited in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));
    }

    private Mono<Transaction> completeDebit(Account account, Transaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long currentBalance = account.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (currentBalance == null || currentBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > currentBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(account.getId(), currentBalance, amount));

            account.setBalance(currentBalance - amount);

            return accountRepository.save(account).flatMap(_ -> {
                transaction.setTransactionStatus(TransactionStatus.SUCCESS);
                transaction.setUpdatedAt(LocalDateTime.now());

                return transactionRepository.save(transaction);
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Void> transfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            balanceValidator.validateTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId);

            return Mono.defer(() -> transferOnce(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId)).timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(maxDurationTimeout)).retryWhen(Retry.backoff(maxRetry, Duration.ofMillis(200)).maxBackoff(Duration.ofSeconds(2)).jitter(0.5).filter(error -> !(error instanceof IdempotencyConflictException) && !(error instanceof TransactionAlreadyCompletedException) && !(error instanceof InsufficientBalanceException) && !(error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) && CreditRetryPolicy.isRetryable(error)).onRetryExhaustedThrow((_, signal) -> signal.failure())).transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(creditCircuitBreaker));
        });
    }

    private Mono<Void> transferOnce(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            boolean sourceFirst = sourceAccountId.compareTo(destinationAccountId) < 0;

            String firstId = sourceFirst ? sourceAccountId : destinationAccountId;

            String secondId = sourceFirst ? destinationAccountId : sourceAccountId;

            Mono<Void> work = lockTransferAccount(firstId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(first -> lockTransferAccount(secondId, sourceAccountId).flatMap(second -> {
                Account source = sourceFirst ? first : second;

                Account destination = sourceFirst ? second : first;

                return transferTransactionRepository.findByIdForUpdate(transactionId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.defer(() -> createPendingTransfer(sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId))).flatMap(transaction -> processTransferTransaction(source, destination, transaction, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount, transactionId));
            })).then();

            return transactionalOperator.transactional(work);
        });
    }

    private Mono<Account> lockTransferAccount(String accountId, String sourceAccountId) {
        String role = accountId.equals(sourceAccountId) ? "Source" : "Destination";

        return accountRepository.findByIdForUpdate(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException(role + " account not found: " + accountId)));
    }

    private Mono<TransferTransaction> createPendingTransfer(String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

        TransferTransaction transaction = TransferTransaction.builder().id(transactionId).sourceAccountId(sourceAccountId).destinationAccountId(destinationAccountId).amount(amount).transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

        return entityTemplate.insert(transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> processTransferTransaction(Account source, Account destination, TransferTransaction transaction, String sourceAccountId, String destinationAccountId, Long amount, String transactionId) {
        boolean sameOperation = Objects.equals(transaction.getSourceAccountId(), sourceAccountId) && Objects.equals(transaction.getDestinationAccountId(), destinationAccountId) && Objects.equals(transaction.getAmount(), amount);

        if (!sameOperation) return Mono.error(new IdempotencyConflictException(transactionId));

        TransactionStatus status = transaction.getTransactionStatus();

        if (status == TransactionStatus.SUCCESS)
            return Mono.error(new TransactionAlreadyCompletedException(transactionId));

        if (status != TransactionStatus.PENDING)
            return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Transaction cannot be transferred in status " + status + ": " + transactionId));

        return completeTransfer(source, destination, transaction);
    }

    private Mono<Void> completeTransfer(Account source, Account destination, TransferTransaction transaction) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            Long sourceBalance = source.getBalance();
            Long destinationBalance = destination.getBalance();
            Long amount = transaction.getAmount();

            if (sourceBalance == null || sourceBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Source account balance is invalid"));

            if (destinationBalance == null || destinationBalance < 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Destination account balance is invalid"));

            if (amount == null || amount <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Amount must be greater than zero"));

            if (amount > sourceBalance)
                return Mono.error(new InsufficientBalanceException(source.getId(), sourceBalance, amount));

            final long newDestinationBalance;

            try {
                newDestinationBalance = Math.addExact(destinationBalance, amount);
            } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {
                return Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Destination balance exceeds the supported range", exception));
            }

            source.setBalance(sourceBalance - amount);
            destination.setBalance(newDestinationBalance);

            return accountRepository.save(source).then(accountRepository.save(destination)).then(Mono.defer(() -> transferTransactionRepository.updateTransferTransactionStatus(transaction.getId(), TransactionStatus.SUCCESS))).flatMap(updatedRows -> {
                if (updatedRows != 1)
                    return Mono.error(new IllegalStateException("Expected to update one transfer transaction, " + "but updated " + updatedRows + ": " + transaction.getId()));

                return Mono.empty();
            });
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Mono<Long> getBalance(String accountId) {
        return accountRepository.findBalanceByAccountId(accountId).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new IllegalArgumentException("Account not found or balance is null: " + accountId)));
    }
}

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.controllers;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.CreditAndDebitRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.GetBalanceRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.TransferRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services.BalanceService;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.utils.GeneralResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.ExampleObject;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

@Tag(name = "Balance Management", description = "Balance management can credit, debit, transfer and retrieve account balances")
@RestController
@RequestMapping("${base-url}/balances")
public class BalanceController {

    private final BalanceService balanceService;

    public BalanceController(BalanceService balanceService) {
        this.balanceService = balanceService;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "credit account", description = "credit an account balance using the provided information.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to charge an account balance", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreditAndDebitRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Account charged successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "charged", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "Account balance charged"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/credit/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> credit(@Valid @RequestBody CreditAndDebitRequest request) {
        return balanceService.credit(request.getAccountId(), request.getAmount(), request.getTransactionId()).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.OK).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("Account balance charged").build()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "debit account", description = "debit an account balance using the provided information.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to decrease an account balance", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreditAndDebitRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Account decreased successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "decreased", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "Account balance decreased"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/debit/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> debit(@Valid @RequestBody CreditAndDebitRequest request) {
        return balanceService.debit(request.getAccountId(), request.getAmount(), request.getTransactionId()).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.OK).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("Account balance decreased").build()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "transfer balance account", description = "transfer an account balance using the provided information.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to transfer an account balance", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = TransferRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Amount transferred successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "transferred", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "Amount transferred"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/transfer/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> transfer(@Valid @RequestBody TransferRequest request) {
        return balanceService.transfer(request.getSourceAccountId(), request.getDestinationAccountId(), request.getAmount(), request.getTransactionId()).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.OK).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("Account balance decreased").build()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Account balance", description = "Retrieve an account balance by account ID.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Account ID required to retrieve an account balance", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GetBalanceRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Account balance 10000", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "Account Balance", value = """
            {
              "title": "Account balance",
              "explanation": "100000"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/get-balance/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> getBalance(@Valid @RequestBody GetBalanceRequest request) {
        return balanceService.getBalance(request.getAccountId()).map(balance -> ResponseEntity.ok(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Account balance").explanation(String.valueOf(balance)).build()));
    }

}

package com.backend.serviceBalance;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.payloads.responses.AccountResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionMethod;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransactionRequest;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.test.context.SpringBootTest;
import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class ServiceBalanceApplicationTests {

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    @Test
    void createAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Hesam", "lastname", "Davarpanah", "username", "test_" + uniqueId, "email", "test_" + uniqueId + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        webTestClient.post().uri(baseURL + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectHeader().contentTypeCompatibleWith(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("User created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void createTransaction_forFirstAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        var accounts = webTestClient.get().uri("/api/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBodyList(AccountResponse.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response must not be null");
        assertFalse(accounts.isEmpty(), "At least one account must exist");

        var firstAccount = accounts.getFirst();

        var request = CreateTransactionRequest.builder().accountId(firstAccount.id()).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(10000L).build();

        webTestClient.post().uri("/api/transactions/create-transaction/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(), "At least one transaction must exist");

        JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

        String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asString();
        String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asString();

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        long amount = firstTransaction.path("amount").asLong();

        Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", amount);
        System.out.printf("Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n", accountId, transactionId);

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                final int requestNumber = i;

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var result = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(creditRequest).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return String.format("Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s", requestNumber, result.getStatus(), result.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Credit workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<String> future : futures) System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf("Final balance for account %s: %s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());

        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void creditAllTransactions_concurrently_thenPrintBalances() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        JsonNode transactions = client.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray(), "Transactions response must be an array");

        record CreditJob(String transactionId, String accountId, long amount, int expectedStatus) {
        }

        record CreditResult(CreditJob job, int actualStatus, String body) {
        }

        List<CreditJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> accountIds = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (JsonNode transaction : transactions) {
            String method = transaction.path("transactionMethod").asString();
            String status = transaction.path("transactionStatus").asString();

            if (!TransactionMethod.CREDIT.name().equals(method)) continue;

            if (!"PENDING".equals(status) && !"SUCCESS".equals(status)) {
                System.out.printf("Skipped transaction %s: status=%s%n", transaction.path("id").asString(), status);
                continue;
            }

            String transactionId = transaction.path("id").asString();
            String accountId = transaction.path("accountId").asString();

            assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
            assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");
            assertTrue(transaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

            long amount = transaction.path("amount").asLong();

            assertTrue(amount > 0, "Credit amount must be positive");

            jobs.add(new CreditJob(transactionId, accountId, amount, "PENDING".equals(status) ? 200 : 409));

            accountIds.add(accountId);
        }

        assertFalse(jobs.isEmpty(), "No PENDING or SUCCESS CREDIT transactions found");

        int concurrency = Math.min(10, jobs.size());

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(concurrency);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<CreditResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CreditResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (CreditJob job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var response = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new CreditResult(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<CreditResult> future : futures) {
                CreditResult result = future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                results.add(result);

                System.out.printf("Transaction=%s | Account=%s | Amount=%d | Status=%d | Body=%s%n", result.job().transactionId(), result.job().accountId(), result.job().amount(), result.actualStatus(), result.body());
            }

            long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 200).count();

            long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 409).count();

            System.out.printf("%nTotal=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n", results.size(), successCount, conflictCount, results.size() - successCount - conflictCount);

            for (String accountId : accountIds) {
                JsonNode balanceResponse = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

                assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

                System.out.printf("Final balance | Account=%s | Balance=%s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());
            }

            assertAll("Concurrent credit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().expectedStatus(), result.actualStatus(), "Unexpected response for transaction " + result.job().transactionId() + ": " + result.body())));
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
```java
}

private List<TransferTestResult> runConcurrentTransfers(
        WebTestClient client,

    ExecutorService executor =
            Executors.newFixedThreadPool(requests.size());

    List<Future<TransferTestResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

            futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {

                        .uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/transfer/")

                        .exchange()
                        .expectBody(String.class)
                        .returnResult();

                return new TransferTestResult(
                        response.getStatus().value(),
                        response.getResponseBody()
                );
            }));
        }

        assertTrue(
                ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                "Transfer workers did not become ready"
        );

        start.countDown();

        List<TransferTestResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Future<TransferTestResult> future : futures) {
            results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        }

        return results;
    } finally {
        start.countDown();
        executor.shutdownNow();
    }
```

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response must not be null");
        assertFalse(accounts.isEmpty(), "At least one account must exist");

        var firstAccount = accounts.getFirst();

        var request = CreateTransactionRequest.builder().accountId(firstAccount.id()).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(10000L).build();

        webTestClient.post().uri("/api/transactions/create-transaction/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(), "At least one transaction must exist");

        JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

        String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asString();
        String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asString();

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        long amount = firstTransaction.path("amount").asLong();

        Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", amount);
        System.out.printf("Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n", accountId, transactionId);

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                final int requestNumber = i;

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var result = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(creditRequest).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return String.format("Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s", requestNumber, result.getStatus(), result.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Credit workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<String> future : futures) System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf("Final balance for account %s: %s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());

        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void creditAllTransactions_concurrently_thenPrintBalances() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        JsonNode transactions = client.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray(), "Transactions response must be an array");

        record CreditJob(String transactionId, String accountId, long amount, int expectedStatus) {
        }

        record CreditResult(CreditJob job, int actualStatus, String body) {
        }

        List<CreditJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> accountIds = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (JsonNode transaction : transactions) {
            String method = transaction.path("transactionMethod").asString();
            String status = transaction.path("transactionStatus").asString();

            if (!TransactionMethod.CREDIT.name().equals(method)) continue;

            if (!"PENDING".equals(status) && !"SUCCESS".equals(status)) {
                System.out.printf("Skipped transaction %s: status=%s%n", transaction.path("id").asString(), status);
                continue;
            }

            String transactionId = transaction.path("id").asString();
            String accountId = transaction.path("accountId").asString();

            assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
            assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");
            assertTrue(transaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

            long amount = transaction.path("amount").asLong();

            assertTrue(amount > 0, "Credit amount must be positive");

            jobs.add(new CreditJob(transactionId, accountId, amount, "PENDING".equals(status) ? 200 : 409));

            accountIds.add(accountId);
        }

        assertFalse(jobs.isEmpty(), "No PENDING or SUCCESS CREDIT transactions found");

        int concurrency = Math.min(10, jobs.size());

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(concurrency);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<CreditResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CreditResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (CreditJob job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var response = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new CreditResult(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<CreditResult> future : futures) {
                CreditResult result = future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                results.add(result);

                System.out.printf("Transaction=%s | Account=%s | Amount=%d | Status=%d | Body=%s%n", result.job().transactionId(), result.job().accountId(), result.job().amount(), result.actualStatus(), result.body());
            }

            long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 200).count();

            long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 409).count();

            System.out.printf("%nTotal=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n", results.size(), successCount, conflictCount, results.size() - successCount - conflictCount);

            for (String accountId : accountIds) {
                JsonNode balanceResponse = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

                assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

                System.out.printf("Final balance | Account=%s | Balance=%s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());
            }

            assertAll("Concurrent credit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().expectedStatus(), result.actualStatus(), "Unexpected response for transaction " + result.job().transactionId() + ": " + result.body())));
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void transfer_sameRequestConcurrently_onlyOneSucceeds() throws Exception {
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        String sourceId = createTransferTestAccount(client);
        String destinationId = createTransferTestAccount(client);

        creditTransferTestAccount(client, sourceId);

        long sourceBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, sourceId);
        long destinationBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, destinationId);

        String transactionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        long amount = 3_000L;

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("sourceAccountId", sourceId, "destinationAccountId", destinationId, "amount", amount, "transactionId", transactionId);

        List<TransferTestResult> results = executeConcurrentTransfers(client, request, request);

        long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 200).count();

        long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 409).count();

        long sourceAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, sourceId);
        long destinationAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, destinationId);

        assertAll(() -> assertEquals(1L, successCount, "Exactly one transfer must succeed: " + results), () -> assertEquals(1L, conflictCount, "The duplicate transfer must return 409: " + results), () -> assertEquals(sourceBefore - amount, sourceAfter, "Source must be debited only once"), () -> assertEquals(destinationBefore + amount, destinationAfter, "Destination must be credited only once"), () -> assertEquals(sourceBefore + destinationBefore, sourceAfter + destinationAfter, "Total balance must remain unchanged"));
    }

    @Test
    void transfer_twoAccountsConcurrently_bothSucceed() throws Exception {
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        String accountA = createTransferTestAccount(client);
        String accountB = createTransferTestAccount(client);

        creditTransferTestAccount(client, accountA);
        creditTransferTestAccount(client, accountB);

        long balanceABefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountA);
        long balanceBBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountB);

        long amountAToB = 3_000L;
        long amountBToA = 2_000L;

        Map<String, Object> requestAToB = Map.of("sourceAccountId", accountA, "destinationAccountId", accountB, "amount", amountAToB, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        Map<String, Object> requestBToA = Map.of("sourceAccountId", accountB, "destinationAccountId", accountA, "amount", amountBToA, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        List<TransferTestResult> results = executeConcurrentTransfers(client, requestAToB, requestBToA);

        long balanceAAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountA);
        long balanceBAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountB);

        assertAll(() -> assertEquals(200, results.getFirst().status(), "A -> B failed: " + results.getFirst()), () -> assertEquals(200, results.get(1).status(), "B -> A failed: " + results.get(1)), () -> assertEquals(balanceABefore - amountAToB + amountBToA, balanceAAfter, "Account A balance is incorrect"), () -> assertEquals(balanceBBefore + amountAToB - amountBToA, balanceBAfter, "Account B balance is incorrect"), () -> assertEquals(balanceABefore + balanceBBefore, balanceAAfter + balanceBAfter, "Total balance must remain unchanged"));
    }

    private record TransferTestResult(int status, String body) {
    }

    private String transferTestBasePath() {
        return baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
    }

    private String createTransferTestAccount(WebTestClient client) {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        String username = "transfer_" + uniqueId;

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Transfer", "lastname", "Test", "username", username, "email", username + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated();

        JsonNode accounts = client.get().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response is null");
        assertTrue(accounts.isArray(), "Accounts response must be an array");

        for (JsonNode account : accounts) {
            if (username.equals(account.path("username").asString())) {
                String accountId = account.path("id").asString();

                assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Created account ID is missing");

                return accountId;
            }
        }

        throw new AssertionError("Created account not found: " + username);
    }

    private void creditTransferTestAccount(WebTestClient client, String accountId) {
        client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId, "amount", 10000L, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString())).exchange().expectStatus().isOk();
    }

    private long readTransferTestBalance(WebTestClient client, String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response, "Balance response is null");
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"), "Balance is missing from response");

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private List<TransferTestResult> executeConcurrentTransfers(WebTestClient client, Map<String, Object> firstRequest, Map<String, Object> secondRequest) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<TransferTestResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Map<String, Object> request : List.of(firstRequest, secondRequest)) {

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");
                    }

                    var response = client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/transfer/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new TransferTestResult(response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Transfer workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            List<TransferTestResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Future<TransferTestResult> future : futures) {
                results.add(future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
            }

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
}

## Assistant

فقط متد `executeConcurrentTransfers` را با این نسخه جایگزین کن. هر دو تست خروجی `Transfer #1` و `Transfer #2` همراه با جزئیات job، status، body و خلاصه نتایج خواهند داشت؛ assertهای فعلی هم بدون تغییر باقی می‌مانند.

```java
private List<TransferTestResult> executeConcurrentTransfers(
        WebTestClient client,
        Map<String, Object> firstRequest,
        Map<String, Object> secondRequest
) throws Exception {
    ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

    CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
    CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

    List<Map<String, Object>> requests =
            List.of(firstRequest, secondRequest);

    List<Future<TransferTestResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

    try {
        for (int i = 0; i < requests.size(); i++) {
            Map<String, Object> request = requests.get(i);

            futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                ready.countDown();

                if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Timed out waiting for concurrent start"
                    );
                }

                var response = client.post()
                        .uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/transfer/")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .bodyValue(request)
                        .exchange()
                        .expectBody(String.class)
                        .returnResult();

                return new TransferTestResult(
                        response.getStatus().value(),
                        response.getResponseBody()
                );
            }));
        }

        assertTrue(
                ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS),
                "Transfer workers did not become ready"
        );

        start.countDown();

        List<TransferTestResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < futures.size(); i++) {
            TransferTestResult result =
                    futures.get(i).get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

            results.add(result);

            Map<String, Object> request = requests.get(i);

            System.out.printf(
                    "Transfer #%d -> Transaction=%s | Source=%s | "
                            + "Destination=%s | Amount=%s | Status=%d | Body=%s%n",
                    i + 1,
                    request.get("transactionId"),
                    request.get("sourceAccountId"),
                    request.get("destinationAccountId"),
                    request.get("amount"),
                    result.status(),
                    result.body()
            );
        }

        long successCount = results.stream()
                .filter(result -> result.status() == 200)
                .count();

        long conflictCount = results.stream()
                .filter(result -> result.status() == 409)
                .count();

        System.out.printf(
                "Transfer summary -> Total=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n",
                results.size(),
                successCount,
                conflictCount,
                results.size() - successCount - conflictCount
        );

        return results;
    } finally {
        start.countDown();
        executor.shutdownNow();
    }
}
```

## Assistant

برای پروژه‌ات یک **Dockerfile چندمرحله‌ای** می‌گذاریم که داخل Docker فایل JAR را بسازد؛ Compose هم شامل **برنامه، PostgreSQL و Redis** می‌شود.

**یک نکته مهم:** در `pom.xml` نسخه Java را `27` گذاشته‌ای. برای نسخه پایدار قابل‌استفاده، پیشنهاد این تنظیمات **Java 25** است. اگر کدت به قابلیت‌های اختصاصی Java 27 وابسته است، این نسخه مناسب نیست و باید image واقعی JDK 27 مورد استفاده‌ات را مشخص کنیم.

## ۱. تغییر نسخه Java در `pom.xml`

این دو مقدار را تغییر بده:

```xml
<java.version>25</java.version>
<maven.compiler.release>25</maven.compiler.release>
```

همچنین چون پروژه‌ات علاوه بر R2DBC، وابستگی‌های JDBC، JPA و Batch دارد، اگر از آن‌ها استفاده می‌کنی، در بخش `dependencies` درایور JDBC PostgreSQL را هم اضافه کن:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
    <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
    <scope>runtime</scope>
</dependency>
```

درایور `r2dbc-postgresql` جایگزین درایور JDBC نیست.

## ۲. فایل `Dockerfile`

کنار `pom.xml` بساز:

```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

# ---------- Build ----------
FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jdk AS build

WORKDIR /workspace

COPY .mvn/ .mvn/
COPY mvnw pom.xml ./

# Normalize Windows line endings and enable execution
RUN sed -i 's/\r$//' mvnw && chmod +x mvnw

COPY src/ src/

# Integration tests need running services, so skip them during image build
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.m2 \
    ./mvnw -B -ntp -Dmaven.test.skip=true clean package \
    && cp target/service-balance-*.jar /workspace/app.jar

# ---------- Runtime ----------
FROM eclipse-temurin:25-jre

WORKDIR /app

# Run as a non-root user
RUN groupadd --system app \
    && useradd --system --gid app --no-create-home app

COPY --from=build --chown=app:app /workspace/app.jar /app/app.jar

USER app

EXPOSE 8080

ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]
```

## ۳. فایل `.dockerignore`

محتوای فعلی را با این جایگزین کن:

```dockerignore
target/
.git/
.idea/
*.iml

.env
.env.*
!.env.example

docker/
docker-compose*.yaml

*.log
```

فایل `.env` وارد image نمی‌شود؛ Compose متغیرهای لازم را هنگام اجرای کانتینر به برنامه می‌دهد.

## ۴. فایل `docker-compose.yaml`

```yaml
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: ../../Desktop
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: service-balance-app:local
    container_name: service-balance-app
    restart: unless-stopped

    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT:-8080}:8080"

    environment:
      SERVER_PORT: "8080"

      # Existing application placeholders, if used in application.yml
      DATABASE_HOST: postgres
      DATABASE_PORT: "5432"
      DATABASE_NAME: ${DATABASE_NAME:?Set DATABASE_NAME in .env}
      DATABASE_USER: ${DATABASE_USER:?Set DATABASE_USER in .env}
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set DATABASE_PASSWORD in .env}

      # JDBC / JPA / Batch
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/${DATABASE_NAME}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME: ${DATABASE_USER}
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD}

      # Reactive PostgreSQL
      SPRING_R2DBC_URL: r2dbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/${DATABASE_NAME}
      SPRING_R2DBC_USERNAME: ${DATABASE_USER}
      SPRING_R2DBC_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD}

      # Redis
      SPRING_DATA_REDIS_HOST: redis
      SPRING_DATA_REDIS_PORT: "6379"

    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  postgres:
    image: postgres:18
    container_name: service-balance
    restart: unless-stopped

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DATABASE_NAME:?Set DATABASE_NAME in .env}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DATABASE_USER:?Set DATABASE_USER in .env}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set DATABASE_PASSWORD in .env}

    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${DATABASE_EXTERNAL_PORT:-5432}:5432"

    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql
      - ./docker/postgres/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-init.sql:ro

    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U "$${POSTGRES_USER}" -d "$${POSTGRES_DB}"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:8
    container_name: service-balance-redis
    restart: unless-stopped

    command: [ "redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes" ]

    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data

    healthcheck:
      test: [ "CMD", "redis-cli", "ping" ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  redis_data:
```

**داخل Docker آدرس دیتابیس `postgres:5432` و Redis برابر `redis:6379` است، نه `localhost`.** پورت Redis به میزبان منتشر نشده چون برنامه داخل شبکه Compose به آن دسترسی دارد.

> نسخه PostgreSQL را از `latest` به `18` ثابت کردم و مسیر volume فعلی‌ات را حفظ کردم. اگر volume موجود با نسخه اصلی دیگری ساخته شده، قبل از اجرای PostgreSQL 18 باید برای مهاجرت آن اقدام کنی؛ تغییر image به‌تنهایی دیتابیس را ارتقا نمی‌دهد.

## ۵. تنظیمات `.env`

این متغیرها را در `.env` موجودت قرار بده یا مقادیر فعلی‌شان را نگه دار:

```dotenv
DATABASE_NAME=service_balance
DATABASE_USER=service_balance_user
DATABASE_PASSWORD=replace_with_a_strong_password

DATABASE_EXTERNAL_PORT=5432
APP_PORT=8080
```

اگر برنامه متغیرهای دیگری مثل کلید JWT یا `BASE_URL` لازم دارد، باید آن‌ها را هم به `environment` سرویس `app` اضافه کنی. **Compose صرفاً با وجود فایل `.env` همه متغیرهایش را وارد کانتینر نمی‌کند.**

چون `application.yml` را نفرستاده‌ای، تنظیمات بالا از کلیدهای استاندارد Spring استفاده می‌کند؛ تنظیمات اختصاصی برنامه، ایجاد جدول‌ها و اجرای Batch همچنان تابع پیکربندی خودت هستند.

## ۶. دستورات اجرا در PowerShell

از همین مسیر پروژه:

```powershell
docker compose up -d --build
```

وضعیت کانتینرها:

```powershell
docker compose ps
```

لاگ برنامه:

```powershell
docker compose logs -f app
```

بازسازی بعد از تغییر کد:

```powershell
docker compose up -d --build app
```

توقف بدون حذف داده‌ها:

```powershell
docker compose down
```

آدرس برنامه با تنظیمات پیش‌فرض:

```text
http://localhost:8080
```

**نکته:** `init.sql` فقط هنگام ایجاد اولیه دیتابیس روی volume خالی اجرا می‌شود، نه هر بار که کانتینر بالا می‌آید. همچنین healthcheckهای بالا آماده‌بودن PostgreSQL و Redis را بررسی می‌کنند؛ برای healthcheck خود برنامه باید یک endpoint مناسب، مثلاً Spring Boot Actuator، داشته باشیم.
