package com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.controllers;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.payloads.requests.CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.payloads.responses.AccountResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.services.AccountService;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.utils.GeneralResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.ExampleObject;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

@Tag(name = "Account Management", description = "Account management can create, read, update and delete accounts")
@RestController
@RequestMapping("${base-url}/accounts")
public class AccountController {

    private final AccountService accountService;

    public AccountController(AccountService accountService) {
        this.accountService = accountService;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create account", description = "Creates a new account using the provided information.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to create an account", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "201", description = "Account created successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "AccountCreated", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "User created successfully"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/create-account/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> createAccount(@Valid @RequestBody CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest request) {
        return accountService.createAccount(request).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("User created successfully").build()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Retrieve accounts", description = "Retrieve accounts", method = "GET", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to create an account", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "201", description = "Account created successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "AccountCreated", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "User created successfully"
            }
            """)))})
    @GetMapping(value = "/retrieve-accounts/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Flux<AccountResponse> retrieveAccounts() {
        return accountService.retrieveAccounts();
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Update account", description = "Updates a new account using the provided information.", method = "PUT", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to update an account", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Account updated successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "AccountUpdated", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "User Updated successfully"
            }
            """)))})
    @PutMapping(value = "/update-account/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> updateAccount(@Valid @RequestBody CreateOrUpdateAccountRequest request, @RequestParam String accountId) {
        return accountService.updateAccount(accountId, request).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.OK).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("User created successfully").build()));
    }
}

package com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.controllers;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.CreditAndDebitRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.GetBalanceRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.payloads.requests.TransferRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.balances.services.BalanceService;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.utils.GeneralResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.ExampleObject;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

@Tag(name = "Balance Management", description = "Balance management can credit, debit, transfer and retrieve account balances")
@RestController
@RequestMapping("${base-url}/balances")
public class BalanceController {

    private final BalanceService balanceService;

    public BalanceController(BalanceService balanceService) {
        this.balanceService = balanceService;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "credit account", description = "credit an account balance using the provided information.", method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to charge an account balance", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreditAndDebitRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Account charged successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "charged", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "Account balance charged"
            }
            """)))})
    @PostMapping(value = "/credit/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> credit(@Valid @RequestBody CreditAndDebitRequest request) {

package com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.controllers;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransactionRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.responses.TransactionResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.services.TransactionService;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.utils.GeneralResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.ArraySchema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.ExampleObject;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

@Tag(name = "Transaction Management", description = "Create and retrieve transactions")
@RestController
@RequestMapping("${base-url}/transactions")
public class TransactionController {

    private final TransactionService transactionService;

    public TransactionController(TransactionService transactionService) {
        this.transactionService = transactionService;
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Create transaction", description = """
            Creates a transaction for an existing account.
            Account ID, transaction method, transaction status and amount
            are required. Amount must be greater than zero.
            """, method = "POST", requestBody = @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.parameters.RequestBody(description = "Information required to create a transaction", required = true, content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = CreateTransactionRequest.class))), responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "201", description = "Transaction created successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, schema = @Schema(implementation = GeneralResponse.class), examples = @ExampleObject(name = "TransactionCreated", value = """
            {
              "title": "Success",
              "explanation": "Transaction created successfully"
            }
            """))), @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = """
            Invalid request body or transaction parameters.
            Amount must be greater than zero.
            """), @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Account not found")})
    @PostMapping(value = "/create-transaction/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<GeneralResponse>> createTransaction(@Valid @RequestBody CreateTransactionRequest request) {
        return transactionService.createTransaction(request).thenReturn(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(GeneralResponse.builder().title("Success").explanation("Transaction created successfully").build()));
    }

    @Operation(summary = "Retrieve transactions", description = """
            Retrieves all transactions.
            Returns an empty array when no transactions exist.
            """, method = "GET", responses = {@ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Transactions retrieved successfully", content = @Content(mediaType = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE, array = @ArraySchema(schema = @Schema(implementation = TransactionResponse.class))))})
    @GetMapping(value = "/retrieve-transactions/", produces = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
    public Flux<TransactionResponse> retrieveTransactions() {
        return transactionService.retrieveTransactions();
    }
}

### ۱. تنظیم سرویس PostgreSQL

در سرویس `postgres` این تنظیمات را قرار بده:

```yaml
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:latest
    container_name: service-balance
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DATABASE_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD}
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "pg_isready -U \"$${POSTGRES_USER}\" -d \"$${POSTGRES_DB}\""
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
```

تنظیمات فعلی `volumes` و سایر بخش‌های سرویس را نگه دار.

### ۲. اصلاح آدرس‌ها برای اجرای داخل Docker

در فایل `.env`:

```dotenv
APPLICATION_HOST=0.0.0.0
APPLICATION_PORT=8000

DATABASE_HOST=postgres
DATABASE_PORT=5432
DATABASE_NAME=service_balance_db
DATABASE_USER=service_balance_admin
DATABASE_PASSWORD='SecurePas$1'

BASE_URL=/api
MAX_RETRY=2
MAX_DURATION_TIMEOUT=3
```

- **`DATABASE_HOST=postgres`**: نام سرویس دیتابیس در Compose است. `localhost` داخل کانتینر برنامه، به خود برنامه اشاره می‌کند، نه دیتابیس.
- **`APPLICATION_HOST=0.0.0.0`**: اگر این متغیر برای آدرس listen برنامه استفاده می‌شود، اجازه می‌دهد برنامه از بیرون کانتینر قابل دسترسی باشد.
- کوتیشن تکی دور رمز در فایل `.env` مناسب است و مانع تفسیر `$` می‌شود.

### ۳. ارسال متغیرها به کانتینر برنامه

فایل `.env` معمولاً برای جایگذاری متغیرهای Compose خوانده می‌شود؛ متغیرها **خودکار به کانتینر برنامه ارسال نمی‌شوند**. در سرویس برنامه، یکی از روش‌های `environment` یا `env_file` را استفاده کن؛ مثلاً:

```yaml
  app: # نام سرویس فعلی برنامه‌ات را نگه دار
    env_file:
      - .env
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
```

### ۴. اجرای مجدد

```bash
docker compose up -d --build
docker compose logs -f postgres
```

**برای این خطا نیازی به حذف volume نیست.** از `docker compose down -v` استفاده نکن، مگر اینکه عمداً بخواهی داده‌های دیتابیس را حذف کنی.

اگر همچنان خطا داشتی، فایل `docker-compose.yml` را بفرست تا تنظیماتش را دقیق اصلاح کنم.

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;

import org.springframework.boot.webtestclient.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureWebTestClient;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.reactive.server.WebTestClient;
import tools.jackson.databind.JsonNode;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = SpringBootTest.WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
@AutoConfigureWebTestClient
class ServiceBalanceApplicationTests {

    @Autowired
    private WebTestClient webTestClient;

    @Value("${base-url}")
    private String baseURL;

    @Test
    void createAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Hesam", "lastname", "Davarpanah", "username", "test_" + uniqueId, "email", "test_" + uniqueId + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        webTestClient.post().uri(baseURL + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectHeader().contentTypeCompatibleWith(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("User created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void createTransaction_forFirstAccount_shouldReturnCreated() {
        var accounts = webTestClient.get().uri("/api/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBodyList(AccountResponse.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response must not be null");
        assertFalse(accounts.isEmpty(), "At least one account must exist");

        var firstAccount = accounts.getFirst();

        var request = CreateTransactionRequest.builder().accountId(firstAccount.id()).transactionMethod(TransactionMethod.CREDIT).amount(10000L).build();

        webTestClient.post().uri("/api/transactions/create-transaction/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated().expectBody().jsonPath("$.title").isEqualTo("Success").jsonPath("$.explanation").isEqualTo("Transaction created successfully");
    }

    @Test
    void creditFirstTransaction_threeConcurrentRequests_thenPrintBalance() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        JsonNode transactions = webTestClient.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray() && !transactions.isEmpty(), "At least one transaction must exist");

        JsonNode firstTransaction = transactions.get(0);

        String transactionId = firstTransaction.path("id").asString();
        String accountId = firstTransaction.path("accountId").asString();

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
        assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");

        assertTrue(firstTransaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

        long amount = firstTransaction.path("amount").asLong();

        Map<String, Object> creditRequest = Map.of("accountId", accountId, "transactionId", transactionId, "amount", amount);
        System.out.printf("Account: %s | Transaction: %s%n", accountId, transactionId);

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(3);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<String>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                final int requestNumber = i;

                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var result = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(creditRequest).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return String.format("Credit #%d -> status=%s, body=%s", requestNumber, result.getStatus(), result.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Credit workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<String> future : futures) System.out.println(future.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));

            JsonNode balanceResponse = webTestClient.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

            assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

            System.out.printf("Final balance for account %s: %s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());

        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void creditAllTransactions_concurrently_thenPrintBalances() throws Exception {
        String basePath = baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        JsonNode transactions = client.get().uri(basePath + "/transactions/retrieve-transactions/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(transactions, "Transactions response is null");
        assertTrue(transactions.isArray(), "Transactions response must be an array");

        record CreditJob(String transactionId, String accountId, long amount, int expectedStatus) {
        }

        record CreditResult(CreditJob job, int actualStatus, String body) {
        }

        List<CreditJob> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> accountIds = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();

        for (JsonNode transaction : transactions) {
            String method = transaction.path("transactionMethod").asString();
            String status = transaction.path("transactionStatus").asString();

            if (!TransactionMethod.CREDIT.name().equals(method)) continue;

            if (!"PENDING".equals(status) && !"SUCCESS".equals(status)) {
                System.out.printf("Skipped transaction %s: status=%s%n", transaction.path("id").asString(), status);
                continue;
            }

            String transactionId = transaction.path("id").asString();
            String accountId = transaction.path("accountId").asString();

            assertFalse(transactionId.isBlank(), "Transaction ID is missing");
            assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Account ID is missing");
            assertTrue(transaction.hasNonNull("amount"), "Transaction amount is missing");

            long amount = transaction.path("amount").asLong();

            assertTrue(amount > 0, "Credit amount must be positive");

            jobs.add(new CreditJob(transactionId, accountId, amount, "PENDING".equals(status) ? 200 : 409));

            accountIds.add(accountId);
        }

        assertFalse(jobs.isEmpty(), "No PENDING or SUCCESS CREDIT transactions found");

        int concurrency = Math.min(10, jobs.size());

        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(concurrency);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Future<CreditResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        List<CreditResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (CreditJob job : jobs) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var response = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", job.accountId(), "transactionId", job.transactionId(), "amount", job.amount())).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new CreditResult(job, response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            start.countDown();

            for (Future<CreditResult> future : futures) {
                CreditResult result = future.get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
                results.add(result);

                System.out.printf("Transaction=%s | Account=%s | Amount=%d | Status=%d | Body=%s%n", result.job().transactionId(), result.job().accountId(), result.job().amount(), result.actualStatus(), result.body());
            }

            long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 200).count();

            long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.actualStatus() == 409).count();

            System.out.printf("%nTotal=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n", results.size(), successCount, conflictCount, results.size() - successCount - conflictCount);

            for (String accountId : accountIds) {
                JsonNode balanceResponse = client.post().uri(basePath + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

                assertNotNull(balanceResponse, "Balance response is null");

                System.out.printf("Final balance | Account=%s | Balance=%s%n", accountId, balanceResponse.path("explanation").asString());
            }

            assertAll("Concurrent credit responses", results.stream().map(result -> () -> assertEquals(result.job().expectedStatus(), result.actualStatus(), "Unexpected response for transaction " + result.job().transactionId() + ": " + result.body())));
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void transfer_sameRequestConcurrently_onlyOneSucceeds() throws Exception {
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        String sourceId = createTransferTestAccount(client);
        String destinationId = createTransferTestAccount(client);

        creditTransferTestAccount(client, sourceId);

        long sourceBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, sourceId);
        long destinationBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, destinationId);

        String transactionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        long amount = 3_000L;

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("sourceAccountId", sourceId, "destinationAccountId", destinationId, "amount", amount, "transactionId", transactionId);

        List<TransferTestResult> results = executeConcurrentTransfers(client, request, request);

        long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 200).count();

        long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 409).count();

        long sourceAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, sourceId);
        long destinationAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, destinationId);

        assertAll(() -> assertEquals(1L, successCount, "Exactly one transfer must succeed: " + results), () -> assertEquals(1L, conflictCount, "The duplicate transfer must return 409: " + results), () -> assertEquals(sourceBefore - amount, sourceAfter, "Source must be debited only once"), () -> assertEquals(destinationBefore + amount, destinationAfter, "Destination must be credited only once"), () -> assertEquals(sourceBefore + destinationBefore, sourceAfter + destinationAfter, "Total balance must remain unchanged"));
    }

    @Test
    void transfer_twoAccountsConcurrently_bothSucceed() throws Exception {
        WebTestClient client = webTestClient.mutate().responseTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(60)).build();

        String accountA = createTransferTestAccount(client);
        String accountB = createTransferTestAccount(client);

        creditTransferTestAccount(client, accountA);
        creditTransferTestAccount(client, accountB);

        long balanceABefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountA);
        long balanceBBefore = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountB);

        long amountAToB = 3_000L;
        long amountBToA = 2_000L;

        Map<String, Object> requestAToB = Map.of("sourceAccountId", accountA, "destinationAccountId", accountB, "amount", amountAToB, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        Map<String, Object> requestBToA = Map.of("sourceAccountId", accountB, "destinationAccountId", accountA, "amount", amountBToA, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString());

        List<TransferTestResult> results = executeConcurrentTransfers(client, requestAToB, requestBToA);

        long balanceAAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountA);
        long balanceBAfter = readTransferTestBalance(client, accountB);

        assertAll(() -> assertEquals(200, results.getFirst().status(), "A -> B failed: " + results.getFirst()), () -> assertEquals(200, results.get(1).status(), "B -> A failed: " + results.get(1)), () -> assertEquals(balanceABefore - amountAToB + amountBToA, balanceAAfter, "Account A balance is incorrect"), () -> assertEquals(balanceBBefore + amountAToB - amountBToA, balanceBAfter, "Account B balance is incorrect"), () -> assertEquals(balanceABefore + balanceBBefore, balanceAAfter + balanceBAfter, "Total balance must remain unchanged"));
    }

    private record TransferTestResult(int status, String body) {
    }

    private String transferTestBasePath() {
        return baseURL.replaceAll("/+$", "");
    }

    private String createTransferTestAccount(WebTestClient client) {
        String uniqueId = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        String username = "transfer_" + uniqueId;

        String phoneNumber = "09" + String.format("%09d", ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(1_000_000_000L));

        Map<String, Object> request = Map.of("firstname", "Transfer", "lastname", "Test", "username", username, "email", username + "@example.com", "phoneNumber", phoneNumber, "status", "ACTIVE", "role", "USER", "password", "SecurePas$1");

        client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/accounts/create-account/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectStatus().isCreated();

        JsonNode accounts = client.get().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/accounts/retrieve-accounts/").accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(accounts, "Accounts response is null");
        assertTrue(accounts.isArray(), "Accounts response must be an array");

        for (JsonNode account : accounts) {
            if (username.equals(account.path("username").asString())) {
                String accountId = account.path("id").asString();

                assertFalse(accountId.isBlank(), "Created account ID is missing");

                return accountId;
            }
        }

        throw new AssertionError("Created account not found: " + username);
    }

    private void creditTransferTestAccount(WebTestClient client, String accountId) {
        client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/credit/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId, "amount", 10000L, "transactionId", UUID.randomUUID().toString())).exchange().expectStatus().isOk();
    }

    private long readTransferTestBalance(WebTestClient client, String accountId) {
        JsonNode response = client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/get-balance/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(Map.of("accountId", accountId)).exchange().expectStatus().isOk().expectBody(JsonNode.class).returnResult().getResponseBody();

        assertNotNull(response, "Balance response is null");
        assertTrue(response.hasNonNull("explanation"), "Balance is missing from response");

        return Long.parseLong(response.path("explanation").asString());
    }

    private List<TransferTestResult> executeConcurrentTransfers(WebTestClient client, Map<String, Object> firstRequest, Map<String, Object> secondRequest) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);

        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(2);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);

        List<Map<String, Object>> requests = List.of(firstRequest, secondRequest);

        List<Future<TransferTestResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            for (Map<String, Object> request : requests) {
                futures.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    ready.countDown();

                    if (!start.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                        throw new IllegalStateException("Timed out waiting for concurrent start");

                    var response = client.post().uri(transferTestBasePath() + "/balances/transfer/").contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).bodyValue(request).exchange().expectBody(String.class).returnResult();

                    return new TransferTestResult(response.getStatus().value(), response.getResponseBody());
                }));
            }

            assertTrue(ready.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "Transfer workers did not become ready");

            start.countDown();

            List<TransferTestResult> results = new ArrayList<>();

            for (int i = 0; i < futures.size(); i++) {
                TransferTestResult result = futures.get(i).get(90, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

                results.add(result);

                Map<String, Object> request = requests.get(i);

                System.out.printf("Transfer #%d -> Transaction=%s | Source=%s | " + "Destination=%s | Amount=%s | Status=%d | Body=%s%n", i + 1, request.get("transactionId"), request.get("sourceAccountId"), request.get("destinationAccountId"), request.get("amount"), result.status(), result.body());
            }

            long successCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 200).count();

            long conflictCount = results.stream().filter(result -> result.status() == 409).count();

            System.out.printf("Transfer summary -> Total=%d | Success=%d | Conflict=%d | Other=%d%n", results.size(), successCount, conflictCount, results.size() - successCount - conflictCount);

            return results;
        } finally {
            start.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
}

اینو چجوری کامل کنم؟

package com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.Transaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.TransferTransaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransactionRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransferTransactionRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.responses.TransactionResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.responses.TransferTransactionResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransactionRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransferTransactionRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
public class TransferTransactionService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository;

    public TransferTransactionService(AccountRepository accountRepository, TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository) {
        this.accountRepository = accountRepository;
        this.transferTransactionRepository = transferTransactionRepository;
    }

    public Mono<TransferTransaction> createTransferTransaction(CreateTransferTransactionRequest request) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            if (request == null || request.getSourceAccountId() == null || request.getDestinationAccountId() == null || request.getTransactionMethod() == null || request.getAmount() == null || request.getAmount() <= 0)
                return Mono.error(new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "invalid transaction parameters, amount must be greater than 0"));

            return accountRepository.findById(request.getSourceAccountId()).switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "account not found"))).flatMap(account -> {
                LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

                TransferTransaction transferTransaction = TransferTransaction.builder().amount(request.getAmount()).sourceAccountId(account.getId()).destinationAccountId().transactionStatus(TransactionStatus.PENDING).createdAt(now).updatedAt(now).build();

                return transferTransactionRepository.save(transferTransaction);
            });
        });
    }

    public Flux<TransferTransactionResponse> retrieveTransferTransactions() {
        return transferTransactionRepository.findAll().map(transferTransaction -> new TransferTransactionResponse(transferTransaction.getId(), transferTransaction.getCreatedAt(), transferTransaction.getUpdatedAt(), transferTransaction.getAmount(), transferTransaction.getSourceAccountId(), transferTransaction.getDestinationAccountId(), transferTransaction.getTransactionStatus()));
    }
}

با فرض اینکه getterها و builder مدل شما همین نام‌ها را دارند، نسخهٔ کامل سرویس:

```java
package com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.services;

import com.backend.serviceBalance.accounts.repositories.AccountRepository;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.TransferTransaction;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.models.enums.TransactionStatus;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.requests.CreateTransferTransactionRequest;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.payloads.responses.TransferTransactionResponse;
import com.backend.serviceBalance.transactions.repositories.TransferTransactionRepository;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;
import reactor.core.publisher.Flux;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;

@Service
public class TransferTransactionService {

    private final AccountRepository accountRepository;
    private final TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository;

    public TransferTransactionService(
            AccountRepository accountRepository,
            TransferTransactionRepository transferTransactionRepository
    ) {
        this.accountRepository = accountRepository;
        this.transferTransactionRepository = transferTransactionRepository;
    }

    public Mono<TransferTransaction> createTransferTransaction(
            CreateTransferTransactionRequest request
    ) {
        return Mono.defer(() -> {
            if (request == null
                    || request.getSourceAccountId() == null
                    || request.getDestinationAccountId() == null
                    || request.getTransactionMethod() == null
                    || request.getAmount() == null
                    || request.getAmount() <= 0) {

                return Mono.error(new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Invalid transaction parameters; amount must be greater than 0"
                ));
            }

            if (request.getSourceAccountId()
                    .equals(request.getDestinationAccountId())) {

                return Mono.error(new ResponseStatusException(
                        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Source and destination accounts must be different"
                ));
            }

            return accountRepository
                    .findById(request.getSourceAccountId())
                    .switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(new ResponseStatusException(
                            HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                            "Source account not found"
                    )))
                    .flatMap(sourceAccount ->
                            accountRepository
                                    .findById(request.getDestinationAccountId())
                                    .switchIfEmpty(Mono.error(
                                            new ResponseStatusException(
                                                    HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND,
                                                    "Destination account not found"
                                            )
                                    ))
                                    .flatMap(destinationAccount -> {
                                        LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();

                                        TransferTransaction transaction =
                                                TransferTransaction.builder()
                                                        .amount(request.getAmount())
                                                        .sourceAccountId(
                                                                sourceAccount.getId()
                                                        )
                                                        .destinationAccountId(
                                                                destinationAccount.getId()
                                                        )
                                                        .transactionStatus(
                                                                TransactionStatus.PENDING
                                                        )
                                                        .createdAt(now)
                                                        .updatedAt(now)
                                                        .build();

                                        return transferTransactionRepository
                                                .save(transaction);
                                    })
                    );
        });
    }

    public Flux<TransferTransactionResponse> retrieveTransferTransactions() {
        return transferTransactionRepository.findAll()
                .map(transaction -> new TransferTransactionResponse(
                        transaction.getId(),
                        transaction.getCreatedAt(),
                        transaction.getUpdatedAt(),
                        transaction.getAmount(),
                        transaction.getSourceAccountId(),
                        transaction.getDestinationAccountId(),
                        transaction.getTransactionStatus()
                ));
    }
}
```

### دو نکتهٔ مهم

**۱. دربارهٔ `transactionMethod`:** در کد فعلی آن را اجباری کرده‌اید، ولی در مدل ذخیره نمی‌کنید. اگر مدل `TransferTransaction` این فیلد را دارد، به builder اضافه کنید:

```java
.transactionMethod(request.getTransactionMethod())
```

اگر انتقال نوع مستقلی است و این فیلد در مدل و درخواست لازم نیست، شرط زیر را از اعتبارسنجی حذف کنید:

```java
|| request.getTransactionMethod() == null
```

در درخواست‌های انتقال تست قبلی شما هم `transactionMethod` ارسال نمی‌شد؛ اگر همان DTO برای آن endpoint استفاده شود، این شرط باعث پاسخ `400` می‌شود.

**۲. این متد فقط یک تراکنش `PENDING` می‌سازد؛ پول منتقل نمی‌کند.** کم‌کردن موجودی مبدأ، افزایش موجودی مقصد و تغییر وضعیت به `SUCCESS` باید در مسیر اجرای انتقال، داخل **یک تراکنش دیتابیس اتمیک** انجام شوند. برای پاس‌شدن تست‌های هم‌زمانی قبلی، کنترل تکراری‌بودن `transactionId` و قفل‌گذاری/کنترل هم‌زمانی موجودی‌ها هم لازم است؛ این سرویس به‌تنهایی آن تضمین‌ها را فراهم نمی‌کند.

بر اساس کدهایی که فرستادی، این محتوای `README.md` برای پروژه **Service Balance** مناسب است. مواردی مثل تنظیمات دیتابیس و نسخهٔ Java را مطابق پروژهٔ خودت تکمیل کن.

````markdown
# Service Balance

سرویس مدیریت تراکنش‌های حساب و ثبت درخواست انتقال بین حساب‌ها، توسعه‌یافته با **Java** و **Spring Boot** با رویکرد **Reactive**.

این پروژه APIهایی برای ثبت و دریافت تراکنش‌ها و تراکنش‌های انتقال ارائه می‌کند.

## فناوری‌ها

- Java
- Spring Boot
- Spring WebFlux
- Project Reactor (`Mono` و `Flux`)
- Jakarta Validation
- OpenAPI / Swagger

> نوع دیتابیس، نسخهٔ Java و ابزار build را مطابق تنظیمات پروژه مشخص کنید.

## قابلیت‌ها

- ثبت تراکنش برای حساب موجود
- دریافت لیست تراکنش‌ها
- ثبت تراکنش انتقال بین دو حساب
- دریافت لیست تراکنش‌های انتقال
- بررسی وجود حساب مبدأ و مقصد
- اعتبارسنجی مبلغ تراکنش
- جلوگیری از انتقال به همان حساب
- بررسی کافی بودن موجودی حساب مبدأ هنگام ثبت درخواست انتقال
- مستندسازی API با annotationهای OpenAPI

## منطق ثبت انتقال

هنگام ایجاد تراکنش انتقال، شرایط زیر بررسی می‌شوند:

1. درخواست نباید خالی باشد.
2. شناسهٔ حساب مبدأ و مقصد الزامی است.
3. روش تراکنش (`transactionMethod`) الزامی است.
4. مبلغ (`amount`) باید بیشتر از صفر باشد.
5. حساب مبدأ و مقصد نباید یکسان باشند.
6. حساب مبدأ و مقصد باید وجود داشته باشند.
7. مبلغ انتقال نباید بیشتر از موجودی حساب مبدأ باشد.

پس از اعتبارسنجی، تراکنش با وضعیت `PENDING` ثبت می‌شود و زمان ایجاد و آخرین تغییر آن تنظیم می‌گردد.

**مبلغ برابر با موجودی حساب مبدأ مجاز است.**

> ثبت تراکنش `PENDING` به معنی اجرای انتقال نیست. در سرویس فعلی، موجودی حساب‌ها کسر، اضافه یا رزرو نمی‌شود.

## APIها

مسیرهای زیر با فرض `base-url: /api` نوشته شده‌اند.

| متد | مسیر | توضیح |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/transactions/create-transaction/` | ایجاد تراکنش |
| `GET` | `/api/transactions/retrieve-transactions/` | دریافت همهٔ تراکنش‌ها |
| `POST` | `/api/transfer-transactions/create-transfer-transaction/` | ایجاد تراکنش انتقال |
| `GET` | `/api/transfer-transactions/retrieve-transfer-transactions/` | دریافت همهٔ تراکنش‌های انتقال |

### ایجاد تراکنش

```http
POST /api/transactions/create-transaction/
Content-Type: application/json
```

طبق قرارداد کنترلر، اطلاعات زیر الزامی هستند:

- شناسهٔ حساب
- روش تراکنش
- وضعیت تراکنش
- مبلغ بیشتر از صفر

نام دقیق فیلدها و مقادیر مجاز را از `CreateTransactionRequest` و enumهای پروژه بررسی کنید.

#### پاسخ موفق

وضعیت HTTP:

```text
201 Created
```

بدنهٔ پاسخ:

```json
{
  "title": "Success",
  "explanation": "Transaction created successfully"
}
```

### دریافت تراکنش‌ها

```http
GET /api/transactions/retrieve-transactions/
```

پاسخ موفق با وضعیت `200 OK` شامل آرایه‌ای از `TransactionResponse` است.

اگر تراکنشی وجود نداشته باشد:

```json
[]
```

### ایجاد تراکنش انتقال

```http
POST /api/transfer-transactions/create-transfer-transaction/
Content-Type: application/json
```

#### فیلدهای درخواست

| فیلد | توضیح |
|---|---|
| `sourceAccountId` | شناسهٔ حساب مبدأ |
| `destinationAccountId` | شناسهٔ حساب مقصد |
| `transactionMethod` | یکی از مقادیر مجاز روش تراکنش در پروژه |
| `amount` | مبلغ مثبت و حداکثر برابر با موجودی حساب مبدأ |

برای نمونهٔ زیر، مقدار شناسه‌ها و روش تراکنش را با مقادیر معتبر پروژه جایگزین کنید. نوع شناسه‌ها نیز باید با DTO مطابقت داشته باشد.

```json
{
  "sourceAccountId": "<SOURCE_ACCOUNT_ID>",
  "destinationAccountId": "<DESTINATION_ACCOUNT_ID>",
  "transactionMethod": "<VALID_TRANSACTION_METHOD>",
  "amount": 1000
}
```

#### پاسخ موفق

وضعیت HTTP:

```text
201 Created
```

بدنهٔ پاسخ:

```json
{
  "title": "Success",
  "explanation": "Transfer transaction created successfully"
}
```

تراکنش ایجادشده با وضعیت `PENDING` ذخیره می‌شود.

### دریافت تراکنش‌های انتقال

```http
GET /api/transfer-transactions/retrieve-transfer-transactions/
```

پاسخ موفق با وضعیت `200 OK` شامل آرایه‌ای از رکوردها با فیلدهای زیر است:

- `id`
- `createdAt`
- `updatedAt`
- `amount`
- `sourceAccountId`
- `destinationAccountId`
- `transactionStatus`

اگر تراکنش انتقالی وجود نداشته باشد:

```json
[]
```

## خطاهای ثبت انتقال

| وضعیت HTTP | دلیل |
|---|---|

| `400 Bad Request` | مبلغ انتقال بیشتر از موجودی حساب مبدأ است |
| `404 Not Found` | حساب مبدأ پیدا نشده است |
| `404 Not Found` | حساب مقصد پیدا نشده است |

پیام‌های تعریف‌شده در سرویس:

Source account not found
Destination account not found
````

````markdown
# Service Balance

Service Balance is a Java Spring Boot backend for managing account-related transaction workflows. It uses Project Reactor to expose reactive APIs for creating and retrieving transfer transactions.

## Features

- Create transfer transactions with a `PENDING` status.
- Retrieve all transfer transactions.
- Validate source and destination accounts.
- Reject transfers with invalid amounts or insufficient source account balance.
- Document API endpoints using OpenAPI annotations.

## Technology Stack

- Java
- Spring Boot
- Spring WebFlux
- Project Reactor (`Mono` and `Flux`)
- Jakarta Validation
- OpenAPI / Swagger annotations

## Transfer Transaction Workflow

When a transfer transaction is requested, the service:

1. Validates the request parameters.
2. Ensures the source and destination accounts are different.
3. Looks up the source account.
4. Checks that the requested amount does not exceed the source account balance.
5. Looks up the destination account.
6. Saves the transfer transaction with:
   - A `PENDING` status
   - The requested amount
   - Source and destination account IDs
   - Creation and update timestamps

> Creating a pending transfer transaction does not deduct, reserve, or transfer account balances. Actual balance updates must be handled separately.

## Validation Rules

A transfer request must satisfy all of the following:

- `sourceAccountId` must be provided.
- `destinationAccountId` must be provided.
- `transactionMethod` must be provided.
- `amount` must be provided and greater than zero.
- Source and destination account IDs must be different.
- Both accounts must exist.
- The amount must not exceed the source account balance.

An amount equal to the source account balance is allowed.

## API Endpoints

The API prefix is configured through the `base-url` property.

The examples below assume:

```properties
base-url=/api
```

### Create a Transfer Transaction

```http
POST /api/transfer-transactions/create-transfer-transaction/
Content-Type: application/json
```

#### Request Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sourceAccountId` | Yes | Identifier of the source account |
| `destinationAccountId` | Yes | Identifier of the destination account |
| `transactionMethod` | Yes | A valid transaction method supported by the application |
| `amount` | Yes | Positive amount not exceeding the source account balance |

Use account identifiers and a transaction method value matching the types defined in the application's request DTO.

#### Successful Response

**Status:** `201 Created`

```json
{
  "title": "Success",
  "explanation": "Transfer transaction created successfully"
}
```

#### Error Responses

| Status | Condition |
|---|---|
| `400 Bad Request` | Missing required parameters or an amount less than or equal to zero |
| `400 Bad Request` | Source and destination accounts are the same |
| `400 Bad Request` | Amount exceeds the source account balance |
| `404 Not Found` | Source account does not exist |
| `404 Not Found` | Destination account does not exist |

Error messages raised by the service include:

```text
Invalid transaction parameters; amount must be greater than 0
Source and destination accounts must be different
Insufficient source account balance
Source account not found
Destination account not found
```

The HTTP error response body depends on the application's error-handling configuration.

### Retrieve Transfer Transactions

```http
GET /api/transfer-transactions/retrieve-transfer-transactions/
```

**Status:** `200 OK`

Returns a JSON array of transfer transactions containing:

- `id`
- `createdAt`
- `updatedAt`
- `amount`
- `sourceAccountId`
- `destinationAccountId`
- `transactionStatus`

If no transfer transactions exist, the endpoint returns an empty array:

```json
[]
```

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- A JDK compatible with the project's build configuration
- Maven or Gradle, depending on the build file included in the repository
- Access to the database and any other infrastructure configured by the application

### Configuration

Before starting the application:

1. Configure the database connection in `application.properties`, `application.yml`, or environment variables.
2. Set the API prefix using `base-url`.
3. Configure the server port if needed.

Example API and server configuration:

```properties

server.port=8080
```

Database settings depend on the persistence technology configured in the project.

### Run the Application

Use the command matching the build tool included in your repository.

#### Maven Wrapper

```bash
./mvnw spring-boot:run
```

#### Gradle Wrapper

```bash
./gradlew bootRun
```

On Windows, use `mvnw.cmd` or `gradlew.bat`.

With the example configuration above, the application is available at:

```text
http://localhost:8080
```

## API Documentation

The transfer controller includes OpenAPI annotations describing request fields, response schemas, and HTTP status codes.

If Swagger UI is enabled through the project's OpenAPI configuration, use its configured URL to explore and test the endpoints.

## Testing

Run tests using the project's build tool:

```bash
# Maven
./mvnw test

# Gradle
./gradlew test
```

Recommended test cases include:

- Creating a valid transfer transaction
- Rejecting missing required fields
- Rejecting zero or negative amounts
- Rejecting identical source and destination accounts
- Rejecting nonexistent accounts
- Rejecting an amount greater than the source balance
- Allowing an amount equal to the source balance
- Verifying that newly created transactions have a `PENDING` status
- Retrieving an empty transaction list

## Implementation Notes

### Balance Consistency

The balance validation performed during transaction creation is a point-in-time check. It does not prevent multiple pending transactions from collectively exceeding the available balance.

When implementing actual transfer execution, validate and update balances atomically using concurrency controls appropriate to the configured database.

### Transaction Method

The current service validates that `transactionMethod` is present, but the shown transaction builder does not persist it.

If transaction methods need to be retained, add the field to the transaction model and save it during creation.
````

## Assistant

حتماً. قبل از متن انگلیسی README، پاسخ بخش‌هایی که داخل پرانتز پرسیدی را به فارسی می‌دهم؛ چون چند مورد نیاز به اصلاح فنی دارند.

## پاسخ پرسش‌های داخل پرانتز

### ۱. آیا چیزی از معماری جا افتاده؟

بهتر است این موارد را هم در معماری توضیح بدهی:

- **Controller:** دریافت درخواست HTTP و تولید پاسخ.
- **Service:** اجرای قواعد کسب‌وکار و اعتبارسنجی انتقال.
- **Repository:** دسترسی به داده‌ها.
- **PostgreSQL:** نگهداری داده‌ها، constraintها و اجرای تراکنش‌های دیتابیس.
- **DTO:** ساختار درخواست‌ها و پاسخ‌های API.
- **مدیریت خطا:** تبدیل خطاهای اعتبارسنجی، نبود حساب و تعارض هم‌زمانی به وضعیت‌های HTTP مناسب.
- **مرز تراکنش:** مشخص کردن اینکه کدام عملیات باید با هم commit یا rollback شوند.

یک اصلاح مهم: **Reactive بودن الزاماً به معنی چندنخی بودن نیست**؛ asynchronous و multithreading هم یک مفهوم نیستند. همچنین تمام `HttpClient`ها blocking نیستند؛ بعضی از آن‌ها اجرای async دارند.

برای اینکه جریان واقعاً non-blocking باشد، دسترسی به دیتابیس نیز باید non-blocking باشد؛ مثلاً با **R2DBC**. اگر از JPA یا JDBC استفاده کرده‌ای، بخش دیتابیس blocking است، حتی اگر خروجی متدها `Mono` یا `Flux` باشد.

### ۲. آیا «استفاده atomic از repositoryها و blocking» تضمین Thread Safety است؟

**نه، به این شکل دقیق نیست.**

استفاده از Repository به‌تنهایی تضمین نمی‌کند که کل فرایند «خواندن موجودی، بررسی موجودی و تغییر موجودی» atomic باشد. Blocking هم به معنی قفل‌گذاری یا جلوگیری از race condition نیست.

برای کنترل هم‌زمانی معمولاً باید یکی از این راهکارها را واقعاً پیاده‌سازی کنی:

- **Optimistic locking** با فیلد version
- **Pessimistic locking** با قفل ردیف دیتابیس
- **Atomic conditional update** و بررسی تعداد ردیف‌های تغییرکرده

همچنین جلوگیری از درخواست تکراری، موضوع **idempotency** است و با کنترل هم‌زمانی روی حساب یکی نیست.

ادعای «فقط یک درخواست موفق می‌شود و بقیه 409 می‌گیرند» هم عمومی نیست: با قفل pessimistic ممکن است درخواست‌ها به‌ترتیب اجرا شوند و چند درخواست معتبر موفق شوند. برای پاسخ `409` باید تشخیص تعارض و نگاشت خطا را پیاده‌سازی کرده باشی.

### ۳. آیا «قفل روی repository» Atomicity انتقال را تضمین می‌کند؟

**خیر؛ قفل به‌تنهایی کافی نیست.**

کسر موجودی مبدأ، افزایش موجودی مقصد و تغییر وضعیت تراکنش باید **داخل یک تراکنش دیتابیس واحد** انجام شوند. اگر هر بخش شکست خورد، همهٔ تغییرات باید rollback شوند.

قفل ردیف‌های حساب برای کنترل هم‌زمانی مفید است، اما **atomicity از تراکنش دیتابیس می‌آید**، نه صرفاً از قفل.

### ۴. آیا کنترل Deadlock در دیتابیس پاسخ درستی است؟

**تا حدی، اما کامل نیست.**

PostgreSQL می‌تواند deadlock را تشخیص دهد و یکی از تراکنش‌ها را لغو کند؛ این به معنی جلوگیری از وقوع deadlock نیست.

برای کاهش احتمال آن:

- حساب‌ها را همیشه با ترتیب ثابت، مثلاً بر اساس شناسه، قفل کن.
- تراکنش‌ها را کوتاه نگه دار.
- داخل تراکنش، درخواست شبکه‌ای یا عملیات طولانی انجام نده.
- برای خطاهای deadlock، در صورت امن بودن عملیات، retry محدود در نظر بگیر.

### یک اصلاح مهم دربارهٔ Idempotency

`transactionStatus = SUCCESS` **به‌تنهایی کافی نیست**؛ دو درخواست هم‌زمان ممکن است هر دو وضعیت قبلی را بخوانند و هر دو اجرا شوند.

شناسهٔ یکتای هر رکورد هم فقط یکتایی رکورد را تضمین می‌کند، نه یکتایی درخواست کسب‌وکار. برای جلوگیری از ایجاد چند تراکنش برای یک درخواست، معمولاً به **idempotency key با unique constraint** نیاز داری. اجرای تراکنش موجود نیز باید با قفل یا تغییر وضعیت شرطی و atomic محافظت شود.

متن زیر را به README انگلیسی اضافه کن. موارد مربوط به concurrency و انتقال واقعی را به‌عنوان **الزامات طراحی** نوشته‌ام، چون در کدی که قبلاً بررسی شد، ثبت `PENDING` به‌تنهایی اجرای atomic انتقال یا idempotency را اثبات نمی‌کند.

````markdown
## Design Decisions and Technical Questions

### Technologies

#### Which technologies are used?

Service Balance uses:

- **Java and Spring Boot** for application development.
- **Spring WebFlux and Project Reactor** for reactive request processing.
- **Docker** for packaging the application and simplifying environment setup.
- **PostgreSQL** for persistent data storage and database-level transaction support.

#### Why were these technologies selected?

**Docker** provides a ready-to-run environment and reduces the need to install and configure application dependencies individually. A compatible container runtime is still required.

**PostgreSQL** is used to:

- Store and manage application data.
- Support database transactions.
- Enforce data integrity through constraints.
- Prevent invalid or duplicate data where appropriate constraints are defined.

**Reactive Spring** supports asynchronous, non-blocking request processing and is suitable for I/O-bound web workloads.

Reactive programming is not the same as multithreading. End-to-end non-blocking behavior also requires non-blocking dependencies, including database access. JDBC and JPA remain blocking; reactive PostgreSQL access can be implemented using R2DBC.

#### What trade-offs do these choices introduce?

- Database development and maintenance require at least basic SQL knowledge.
- Docker simplifies deployment but requires a supported container runtime and host environment.
- Some Docker environments, particularly desktop environments, require virtualization support.
- Reactive programming introduces additional complexity in debugging, error handling, and transaction management.
- Database locking improves consistency but may increase contention and waiting time.

### Same-Account Transfers

#### How does the system behave when the source and destination accounts are the same?

The system rejects the request with `400 Bad Request`.

No transfer transaction is created, and account balances remain unchanged.

This behavior follows the expected business rule for bank-style transfers: a transfer must involve two different accounts.

### Architecture

#### What is the overall solution structure?

Service Balance follows a layered architecture:

```text
HTTP Client
    |
    v
Controller
    |
    v
Service
    |
    v
Repository
    |
    v
PostgreSQL
```

Docker provides the deployment environment around the application and its configured dependencies.

#### What are the main system components?

- **Controllers:** Handle HTTP requests and responses.
- **Services:** Implement business rules and transaction workflows.
- **Repositories:** Provide access to persisted data.
- **Request and response DTOs:** Define API contracts.
- **Models and enums:** Represent accounts, transactions, and transaction states.
- **PostgreSQL:** Stores data and provides constraints, locking, and transactional guarantees.
- **Error handling:** Maps validation failures, missing resources, and concurrency conflicts to appropriate HTTP responses.

#### Why use Reactive Spring?

Reactive Spring supports asynchronous, non-blocking processing, allowing the application to handle I/O without dedicating a blocked thread to every request.

This advantage depends on the entire execution path being non-blocking. Wrapping blocking operations in `Mono` or `Flux` does not automatically make them non-blocking.

HTTP clients are not inherently blocking; both blocking and asynchronous implementations exist.

### Concurrency

#### How is thread safety and concurrent data consistency ensured?

Repository usage alone does not guarantee atomicity across multiple operations.

Shared account state must be protected through database-level concurrency control, such as:

- Optimistic locking with a version field.
- Pessimistic row-level locking.
- Atomic conditional updates.

Related balance changes must also execute within an appropriate database transaction.

Blocking execution is not a substitute for concurrency control.

#### Why use database-level concurrency control?

Database-level concurrency control helps prevent lost updates and inconsistent account balances.

It also protects shared data when requests are processed by different application threads or multiple application instances.

Duplicate-request prevention is handled separately through idempotency controls.

#### What happens when concurrent operations target the same account?

The outcome depends on the selected concurrency strategy:

- With pessimistic locking, operations may wait and execute sequentially.
- With optimistic locking, conflicting updates may fail.
- With conditional updates, operations succeed only if their database conditions still hold.

A detected application-level conflict can be returned as `409 Conflict` when the corresponding error mapping is implemented.

Concurrent requests are not automatically rejected, and more than one valid request may succeed.

> The pending-transfer creation flow alone does not establish these concurrency guarantees. They must be implemented in the balance-update or transfer-execution workflow.

### Idempotency

#### How is repeated execution of a transaction prevented?

A `SUCCESS` status indicates that a transaction has completed, but checking this status alone is not sufficient under concurrency.

A robust implementation requires:

1. A unique idempotency key identifying the business request.
2. A database uniqueness constraint on that key.
3. Atomic protection of transaction execution through locking or a conditional state transition.
4. Balance changes and the final transaction status update within the same database transaction.

A repeated request should refer to the existing transaction rather than create and execute another one.

#### What happens if the same transaction request arrives multiple times concurrently?

With an idempotency key and a database uniqueness constraint, only one transaction record can be created for that key.

Other requests can retrieve the existing result or receive an appropriate in-progress or conflict response, depending on the API contract.

A unique generated transaction ID does not prevent duplicate business requests: each duplicate request could otherwise receive a different ID.

> Transaction status and generated IDs alone do not establish idempotency.

### Transfer Atomicity

#### How is transfer atomicity guaranteed?

For actual transfer execution, the following operations must run in one database transaction:

1. Validate or revalidate the available source balance.
2. Debit the source account.
3. Credit the destination account.
4. Update the transfer transaction status.

All changes must commit together or roll back together.

Row-level locking can protect account balances from concurrent updates, but locking alone does not guarantee atomicity.

In a reactive persistence implementation, transaction boundaries must use transaction management compatible with the reactive database driver.

> Creating a transfer with a `PENDING` status does not execute the transfer, reserve funds, or provide atomic balance updates.

### Deadlocks

#### Can deadlocks occur?

Yes. Deadlocks can occur when concurrent database transactions acquire conflicting locks in different orders.

For example, one transaction may lock account A and then account B while another locks account B and then account A.

#### How can deadlock risk be reduced?

- Lock account rows in a consistent order, such as ascending account ID.
- Keep database transactions short.
- Avoid external network calls while holding database locks.
- Apply bounded retries for deadlock failures when retrying is safe.

PostgreSQL detects deadlocks and aborts one of the involved transactions. This is a recovery mechanism, not a guarantee that deadlocks cannot occur.

## Implementation Status

The currently reviewed transfer-creation flow validates the request and stores a transaction with the `PENDING` status.

Database-level concurrency control, idempotent execution, atomic balance updates, and deadlock retry behavior should only be considered implemented once the corresponding code, database constraints, and tests are present.
````

    @Query("""
